Philippines deploys India’s BrahMos missiles in military exercise amid China-Taiwan tensions

The first confirmed BrahMos field deployment in DAGIT-PA military exercise highlights Manila’s push to defend its northern approaches amid concerns over a potential Taiwan conflict.

Harini Ts

26 November, 2026 07:28 pm IST

Follow Us:

New Delhi: The Philippines has fielded its BrahMos shore-based anti-ship missile battery in coordination with naval vessels during its annual joint defence exercise under the looming shadow of a potential China-Taiwan conflict.

The 10th iteration of AFP Joint Exercise (AJEX) DAGITPA 10-2026, held from 17 to 27 November, includes operations in Northern Luzon, Palawan, the National Capital Region, and the Western Command area, focusing on defending the country’s northern maritime approaches in the backdrop of China’s growing naval presence.

The Philippine Marine Corps’ Coastal Defence Regiment (CDR), according to the US Naval Institute (USNI), deployed the missile battery for a joint maritime strike exercise during DAGIT-PA.

Show Full Article

The exercise marks the first confirmed field deployment of the BrahMos system during this series of drills, following earlier rehearsals during Balikatan 2026. It also involved movement of air-defence systems to Northern Luzon, naval escorts protecting military transport and special forces operations on Fuga Island.

WATCH | AFP WRAPS UP AJEX DAGITPA 2026

The Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) successfully concludes AJEX DAGITPA 10-2026, a ten-day joint and combined exercise held from November 17 to 27 across Northern Luzon and Palawan.

Bringing together the Philippine Army, Philippine… pic.twitter.com/aSNQ7scpiO

— Armed Forces of the Philippines (@TeamAFP) November 26, 2026

The Philippine military said the drills were aimed at strengthening its ability to secure vital maritime approaches, particularly the Luzon Strait.

Also Read: India successfully test-fires JWALA MK-1: Small, cost-effective, smart anti-drone missile from pvt sector

Luzon Strait & its importance Separating the northern Philippines from Taiwan and connecting the South China Sea with the Western Pacific, the Luzon Strait is an important passage for commercial shipping and naval movements.

The strait’s location makes it significant in the event of a conflict over Taiwan. Any escalation could affect the Philippines’ northern islands, including Batanes, and bring the country closer to the military consequences of a cross-strait confrontation. Manila has increased its military presence and conducted area-denial exercises with the US in the region.

Given the presence of commercial shipping routes and undersea communications cables, any military escalation around Taiwan can disrupt maritime traffic and affect regional trade. For the Philippines, the northern islands are particularly exposed to conflict spilling over from Taiwan.

This explains Manila’s increased military activity in northern Luzon and the Batanes region. Deploying BrahMos missiles during DAGIT-PA forms part of its effort to bolster coastal defences and deter hostile naval activity near these strategic approaches.

The Chinese reaction While the BrahMos deployment has not received comparable attention from Chinese state media outlets, several commentators have examined the implications of India’s missile exports to Manila and the potential threat to Chinese naval vessels operating in the South China Sea.

In January 2022, India and the Philippines signed a $375-million contract for three BrahMos anti-ship missile batteries. The agreement made Manila the first foreign customer of the system, jointly developed by India’s Defence Research and Development Organisation and Russia’s NPO Mashinostroyeniya. The first delivery took place in April 2024.

Some of the commentators have questioned whether the Philippines has the monitoring, target tracking, communications and operational capabilities required to use the missiles effectively against higher technological opponents.

Their discussions point out that the missile’s performance would depend not only on its speed and range, but also on supporting capabilities such as electronic warfare, reliable communications and a clear operational picture.

India, according to a Reuters report in the first week of November, is in final-stage talks with the Philippines for a potential follow-on deal worth $700 million to $800 million. Manila is considering around five additional systems, involving nearly 60 missiles, and exploring ways to adapt the system to its local environment and logistical framework.

The recent deployment places the BrahMos missile at the centre of Manila’s efforts to strengthen coastal security, while highlighting India’s expanding footprint as an arms supplier in the Indo-Pacific region.

(Edited by Tony Rai)

item.title: Anthropic chief says claims that he wants humans to ‘surrender’ to AI are ‘absurd’
item.description: Anthropic chief executive Dario Amodei on Wednesday denied wanting humanity to give up its free will to AI, calling it “absurd” to attribute the idea to him as rival tech leaders push back.
item.dc:creator: AFP Staff
item.content:encoded: Anthropic chief executive Dario Amodei on Wednesday denied wanting humanity to give up its free will to AI, calling it “absurd” to attribute the idea to him as rival tech leaders push back. “No, I do not believe that we should ‘surrender human free will’ to AI systems, and it’s absurd to suggest that I do,” Amodei wrote in a lengthy post on X, a week after Anthropic’s record-setting stock market debut. “We should never sacrifice legitimacy or self-determination at the altar of efficiency or security,” he added. Fears that AI tools could slip out of human control have haunted Silicon Valley since a string of incidents this summer, including the hacking of Hugging Face by autonomous AI agents developed by OpenAI. “We really do earnestly believe AI could kill all humans!” an Anthropic safety lead, Evan Hubinger, wrote in September. Amodei took aim, without naming names, at “some AI CEOs” who repeat slogans like “AI should be just a tool” but then are not “actually doing anything different in their products.” On Sunday, Meta’s Chief AI Officer Alexandr Wang wrote on X that “we should not be okay with a ‘handover’ of society to AI.” OpenAI CEO Sam Altman said earlier this month that if the tradeoff for curing cancer is “you are going to lose all agency and control and voice in the future,” that is “a terrible sales pitch.” Amodei’s post was in response to an article by US outlet Axios on AI debate, though he did not address his previous remarks on the topic. In February, Amodei told The New York Times that in “life-critical, safety-critical cases, we really want to turn it over” to AI. And in late 2024, he predicted that AI systems “will be the leaders, and they’ll be ordering humans or other AI systems around.” On Wednesday, he acknowledged that “we may want limits” on recursive self-improvement, or RSI, in which AI models can autonomously create new versions of itself, and that “we don’t expect it to be safe for Claude to build successive frontier models fully autonomously,” without saying where the line should be drawn. Yet in its IPO filing, Anthropic said that “each new version of a Claude model directly accelerates development of the next,” and that Claude wrote over 90 percent of the contributions to its codebase in September. Elon Musk, who has long predicted that superintelligent AI would leave humans “like pet Labradors,” reposted Amodei’s statement with a one-word comment: “interesting.”

item.title: ＥＣＢ10月理事会、利上げ容認の声多く データ裏付けと認識＝議事要旨
item.description: ［フランクフルト ２６日 ロイター］ - 欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）が２６日に公表した１０月２８─２９日の理事会の議事要旨...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＥＣＢ10月理事会、利上げ容認の声多く　データ裏付けと認識＝議事要旨 22:51 配信

欧州中央銀行（ECB）の建物　2022年10月撮影　 REUTERS/Wolfgang Rattay/File Photo（ロイター） ［フランクフルト　２６日　ロイター］ - 欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）が２６日に公表した１０月２８─２９日の理事会の議事要旨で、理事会メンバーが利上げに傾いていたものの、インフレリスクを見極める材料をさらに集めるため、先送りを選んだことが分かった。

同理事会は金利を据え置いた。ただインフレ率は従来の想定より高くなる可能性が高く、一段の引き締めが必要になるかもしれないと警告した。

議事要旨は「多くのメンバーは、９月の理事会以降に入手したデータが一段の金融引き締めの根拠を裏付けたことから、今回の会合で利上げを支持することもできたと指摘した」と記している。

メンバーは、インフレの二次的波及効果はまだ表れていないものの、それを未然に防ぐ必要があるとの認識で一致した。

１０月の利上げの可能性について、議事要旨は「今回の会合で利上げしても、必要な金融引き締めを前倒しするだけになる」としている。

同理事会以降、理事会メンバーの多くが公の場や非公式の発言で、１２月１７日の理事会で０．２５％の利上げを示唆している。

item.title: Global stocks rise and tech shares rebound as U.S. closes for Thanksgiving
item.description: U.S. stock futures also climbed, with the S&P 500 futures up 0.5 per cent. U.S. markets will reopen Friday for a holiday-shortened session.
item.dc:creator: The Associated Press
item.content:encoded: HONG KONG — Shares advanced in Europe and Asia on Thursday while U.S. markets were closed for the Thanksgiving holiday. Buying of stocks tied to artificial intelligence helped push benchmarks in Asia higher, though some profit-taking by investors toward the end of the day pared those gains. Investors have been growing cautious about the AI trade. They also are watching for impacts from the latest tariff hikes Washington plans to impose on China, Japan, the European Union and other trading partners. In early European trading, Germany’s DAX jumped 1.9 per cent to 25,180.12, while France’s CAC 40 climbed 1.8 per cent to 8,126.47. Britain’s FTSE 100 added 1.6 per cent to 10,591.83. U.S. stock futures also climbed, with the S&P 500 futures up 0.5 per cent. U.S. markets will reopen Friday for a holiday-shortened session. In Asia, Japan’s Nikkei 225 rebounded and closed 0.9 per cent higher at 57,499.16. OpenAI investor SoftBank Group jumped 7.3 per cent, while memory chipmaker Kioxia Holdings surged 12.6 per cent. Shares of chip equipment maker Tokyo Electron were up 0.6 per cent. South Korea’s benchmark Kospi index added 0.3 per cent to 4,711.21 after a 6.2 per cent drop a day earlier. Samsung Electronics gained 0.4 per cent, while memory chipmaker SK Hynix rose 2.2 per cent. Taiwan’s Taiex was 2.5 per cent higher. But shares of its leading chipmaker TSMC, or Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co., edged 0.2 per cent lower. Hong Kong’s Hang Seng index was 1.2 per cent higher at 22,226.88. The Shanghai Composite index was up less than 0.1 per cent at 3,476.88. Australia’s S&P/ASX 200 gained 0.8 per cent to 8,763.80. India’s Sensex rose 0.5 per cent. Wall Street closed mixed ahead of the Thanksgiving holiday. The benchmark S&P 500 index lost 0.3 per cent Wednesday after falling as much as 3.2 per cent earlier in the day. The technology-heavy Nasdaq composite closed 0.6 per cent lower, after recovering from a drop of as much as 4.6 per cent. The Dow Jones Industrial Average picked up 0.3 per cent. Nvidia fell 3.9 per cent as AI shares lost steam for a second day after Jensen Huang’s comeback as CEO. On Wednesday, S&P Global Ratings warned it could downgrade Nvidia’s credit rating over concerns surrounding its management and governance. Broadcom, which had fallen sharply earlier in the day, was 0.1 per cent lower at the close. Anthropic, which began public trading last week, recovered from an early drop and ended 1.1 per cent higher, though still below its IPO, or initial public offering, price of US$83 per share. In commodities trading, oil prices climbed early Thursday as tensions in the Middle East persisted even as global oil supply continued to recover. Brent crude, the international standard, was 0.5 per cent higher at $91.09 per barrel. It was trading at approximately $72 a barrel before the war began in late February. Benchmark U.S. crude gained one per cent to $84.51 per barrel. Recent reports of vessels being targeted in the Strait of Hormuz, a crucial waterway for global oil transport, have contributed to concerns over oil flows and “brought supply risks back into focus,” ING commodities strategists Ewa Manthey and Warren Patterson said in a commentary Thursday. The U.S. dollar rose to 159.30 Japanese yen from 159.16 yen. The euro was trading at $1.0968, down from $1.0974. Chan Ho-him, The Associated Press

item.title: Zcash Whale Wakes Up After 9 Years, Moves $11.39 Million To Kraken
item.description: Key takeawaysNine years is an eternity in crypto. Yet one Zcash whale appears to have spent that long sitting on an investment made during the privacy coin’s early days. On Thursday, blockchain ...
item.content:encoded:
News / NewsBTC / Zcash Whale Wakes Up After 9 Years, Moves $11.39 Million To Kraken

Zcash Whale Wakes Up After 9 Years, Moves $11.39 Million To Kraken 3 min read

ZECUSD Key takeaways Lookonchain reports a Zcash whale moved 15,750 ZEC, about $11.39 million, to Kraken after nine years. The whale reportedly bought 23,412 ZEC in 2017 at about $215 (just over $5 million). The deposit is roughly two-thirds of that position. At about $723 per ZEC, the coins are worth around $8 million more than their estimated cost, a gain of roughly 236%. A deposit to an exchange is not proof of a sale, and the acquisition price is an estimate, not a verified record. More early holders moving dormant coins to exchanges could mean new Zcash buyers absorb supply from older holders. Nine years is an eternity in crypto. Yet one Zcash whale appears to have spent that long sitting on an investment made during the privacy coin’s early days. On Thursday, blockchain monitoring platform Lookonchain reported that the investor had moved 15,750 ZEC, worth $11.39 million, to Kraken. The coins date back to 2017, when Ethereum was still a relatively young network, decentralized finance barely existed and Zcash was attempting to establish itself as a more private alternative to Bitcoin. Almost a decade later, the wallet is active again. And its owner’s reported acquisition price makes the transaction particularly interesting.

A $5 Million Bet On Zcash In 2017 According to Lookonchain, the whale originally acquired 23,412 ZEC at an average price of approximately $215, representing an investment of just over $5 million. The latest transactions account for roughly two-thirds of that original position, with at least 7,750 ZEC transferred to a Kraken deposit address.

At the reported transfer valuation of approximately $723 per ZEC, those 15,750 coins are worth around $8 million more than their estimated acquisition cost. That would represent a return of approximately 236% if the investor sold them at that price.

What makes this wallet fascinating, however, is what happened between those two valuations. Zcash spent much of 2024 and early 2025 trading around $16 to $20 before staging a remarkable comeback. At $20 per coin, the whale’s original investment would have been worth less than $470,000, a paper loss of more than 90%, assuming the position remained intact. Holding an asset through a temporary market correction is one thing. Holding it through years of declining relevance, while newer cryptocurrencies attract developers, investors and attention, is something else entirely. Whatever the owner’s reasons for keeping the coins untouched, the decision has aged considerably better than it appeared to during Zcash’s quieter years. The Interesting Paradox Behind A Zcash Whale There is something almost ironic about the fact that investors are following the movements of a whale holding one of crypto’s best-known privacy coins. Unlike networks where transaction privacy is mandatory, Zcash supports both transparent and shielded transactions. Transparent addresses allow observers to examine balances and transfers, while shielded transactions use zero-knowledge cryptography to conceal transaction details. That distinction explains how blockchain monitoring platforms can identify certain large ZEC movements despite the cryptocurrency’s privacy capabilities. It also explains why the available information tells only part of the story. Lookonchain can identify an apparent exchange deposit and estimate its value. Establishing who controls the wallet, whether ownership changed privately during those nine years or what the investor intends to do next is considerably harder. Even the reported acquisition price is an estimate rather than a verified record of the owner’s personal trading history. That is an important limitation of on-chain analysis, particularly when dealing with a network explicitly designed to give users greater control over their financial visibility. Zcash’s Comeback Has Given Early Investors An Exit The renewed enthusiasm surrounding Zcash has attracted a different kind of investor from the one buying ZEC in 2017. Corporate treasury strategies have emerged, institutional investors have taken an interest in privacy-focused assets, and the debate over financial surveillance has given Zcash a fresh investment narrative. NewsBTC previously reported that Winklevoss Capital backed the launch of a dedicated Zcash treasury strategy, illustrating how exposure to the cryptocurrency has begun extending beyond traditional crypto wallets. But the revival of an old cryptocurrency also comes with an interesting complication: investors who have spent years underwater finally have an opportunity to recover their capital or take profits. That does not necessarily make the Kraken deposit bearish. A transfer to an exchange is not proof of a completed sale, and one wallet cannot establish a broader trend among Zcash holders. Still, the transaction is worth watching. If more early investors start moving dormant coins onto exchanges, Zcash’s new buyers may find themselves absorbing supply from an entirely different generation of holders. Nine years ago, someone reportedly committed more than $5 million to the idea of private digital money. Today, the blockchain offers a glimpse of what that investment has become. Whether the owner has finished holding Zcash is a question the blockchain alone cannot yet answer.

item.title: 豪ＬＮＧ輸出規制法案、最終採決来年2月に延期 国内供給確保
item.description:
Christine Chen Helen Clark
［シドニー／パース ２６日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Christine Chen　Helen Clark

［シドニー／パース　２６日　ロイター］ - オーストラリア上院は２６日、液化天然ガス（ＬＮＧ）生産者に生産量の最大５分の１を国内向けに確保するよう義務付ける規則について、最終採決を２０２７年２月に延期した。

上院は国内ガス留保法案の第２読会を開き、賛成２１、反対１０で可決した。しかし、同法案を担当するエアーズ産業相は、主に手続き上の第３読会を提案した上で、上院が再開する２７年２月まで延期するよう求めた。

政府は５年ごとの独立した見直しなどの修正を土壇場で加えた。このため法案は、成立前に最終採決のため下院へ差し戻される必要が生じていた。

法案は市場へのガス供給を増やすことが目的で、条文自体はすでに合意されているが、成立は２７年になる。

制度は２８年１月に施行する予定。確保する正確な量はエネルギー規制当局が決める。予測需要の１１０％に当たる余剰を生み出す設計で、政府はこれを「適度な供給過剰」と説明している。同国産ガスの二大購入国である中国と日本は、同制度に懸念を示している。

野党側は、現行の留保政策では国内のガス開発が十分に促されないことを懸念。

中道左派のアルバニージー政権は、国内最大のＬＮＧ輸出州である西オーストラリア州を適用除外とすることで暫定合意し、野党の支持を得た。ただ、この除外は正式で恒久的なものではなく、閣僚の監督の下に置かれる。

ガス生産会社は、供給者に「販売しなければならない」義務を課す条項があるとして反対している。企業側は価格が下がり過ぎて、新規供給への投資が妨げられると主張する。

Marlboro maker Altria explores takeover of UK's Imperial Brands

FAST

Nov 26 : US tobacco group Altria said on Thursday it was considering a possible all-cash offer for Imperial Brands and was in talks with another party over part of the British company's business, as Japan Tobacco also was reported to be weighing a bid. Shares in London-listed Imperial Brands soared as much as 17.6 per cent to 3,562 pence, giving it a market capitalisation of £26.77 billion ($35.07 billion). Bloomberg News earlier on Thursday reported that Japan Tobacco is evaluating a potential acquisition of Imperial Brands, citing people familiar with the matter. Last week, Imperial Brands, which makes Winston cigarettes, announced plans to cut up to 4,600 jobs, or nearly a fifth of its workforce as it tightens its grip on costs amid falling cigarette volumes and rising competition.

Imperial's brands also include Davidoff, Gauloises, West and Kool menthol cigarettes, as well as Rizla rolling papers. Japan Tobacco's portfolio includes Camel and Benson & Hedges. Altria's family of companies includes Philip Morris USA — the maker of Marlboro in the United States. Altria said it was also in discussions with a third party for a part of Imperial Brands' business, although no agreement had yet been reached. The Japanese group has been speaking with advisers as it weighs a possible transaction, the report said, adding that JT has considered teaming up with a partner to buy Imperial and then split up the British company's assets in different parts of the world. Imperial Brands declined to comment and Japan Tobacco did not immediately respond to a request for comment. A deal for Imperial Brands would rank among the largest recent acquisitions of a British company by an overseas buyer. ($1 = 0.7634 pounds)

Source: Reuters

item.content:encoded: Bloomberg — Elon Musk y SpaceX ( SPCX ) regalarán a cada niño de Estados Unidos dos acciones de la compañía de exploración espacial, duplicando así el compromiso que la persona más rica del mundo asumió el mes pasado. SpaceX donará una acción de nueva emisión de su capital social Clase A a cada cuenta de Trump activa, según informó la compañía en un comunicado el miércoles. Como parte de su compromiso de donar una acción de SpaceX a cada niño en Estados Unidos, Musk igualará personalmente la cantidad de acciones donadas por SpaceX. Ver más: Musk promete regalar acciones de SpaceX a “todos los niños de Estados Unidos” Según estimaciones de la Oficina del Censo de EE.UU., hay aproximadamente 72 millones de niños en Estados Unidos, lo que haría que la donación valiera alrededor de US$18.400 millones al precio actual de las acciones. La presidenta de SpaceX, Gwynne Shotwell, anunció por separado que donará más de 2 millones de acciones de SpaceX. El comunicado no especificó cómo se distribuirán. Musk es, con diferencia, la persona más rica del mundo, con un patrimonio neto de aproximadamente US$820.000 millones, según el Índice de Multimillonarios de Bloomberg. Sus acciones de SpaceX representan la gran mayoría de esa fortuna, unos US$650.000 millones, mientras que el resto proviene de Tesla Inc. ( TSLA ), Boring Co. y Neuralink. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

item.title: Auto sector in Canada is moving away from U.S. imports: DesRosiers
item.description: A new report suggests the Canadian auto sector is starting to pivot away from U.S. imports toward other global markets amid the ongoing trade war.
item.dc:creator: The Canadian Press
item.content:encoded: A new report suggests the Canadian auto sector is starting to pivot away from U.S. imports toward other global markets amid the ongoing trade war. The data analysis from DesRosiers Automotive Consultants showed that light vehicle imports from the United States have accounted for 40 per cent of Canada’s total thus far in 2026 when measured by dollars. That result is down from 49.1 per cent of Canada’s light vehicle imports in 2024. Meanwhile, most other markets saw their shares rise from two years ago. The proportion of Canada’s light vehicle imports from Mexico increased from 16.7 per cent in 2024 to 20.5 per cent so far this year, while Japan saw an increase to 12.9 per cent from 10.7 per cent in 2024. Imports from South Korea have risen from 10.4 to 12.5 per cent, and the combined European markets saw a bump from 9.8 to 11.1 per cent. Aside from Canada’s southern neighbour, China was the only market behind its 2024 share at 2.6 per cent thus far in 2026, down from 2.9 per cent. The overall shift is notable given that not all manufacturers are affected by Canada’s counter-tariffs, which exclude some of the highest volume players, the report said. DesRosiers managing partner Andrew King said certain manufacturers affected by the tariff situation “have moved rapidly to seek other sourcing where possible and to continue to provide Canadians with vehicles at the best possible price.” “What the U.S. lost in share was captured readily by the other major light vehicle exporters, with the trade war helping to diversify Canada’s sourcing in this space,” he said in a statement. Vehicles made in Canada are tariffed by the United States at 25 per cent, minus their American content, while auto and truck parts that comply with the Canada-United States-Mexico agreement on trade are exempt.  In August, President Donald Trump threatened to hike tariffs on all vehicles, auto parts and steel from Canada to 50 per cent on Jan. 1. Canada maintains import duties of 25 per cent on U.S. autos that are not compliant with CUSMA. Ottawa allows automakers to import a quota of vehicles made in the United States tariff-free, based in part on their level of automotive assembly in Canada. Automotive analyst Daniel Ross said the figures show manufacturers are “fighting ... to keep prices from climbing.” “I think it’s directly related to trade policy and the trade war at hand,” said Ross, senior manager of auto industry insights at Canadian Black Book. “A lot of manufacturers are finding their way to decrease dependency for the Canadian market based off of what’s happening in the U.S. So the narrative is, ultimately, where else can we get these? Where is it easier? Where can we work with?” Prime Minister Mark Carney said in recent weeks that trade talks with the U.S. are making progress, but Ottawa won’t accept a deal that doesn’t allow for a viable auto sector. That came three months after Canada pulled out of trade talks with the U.S. due to last-minute demands from Washington that included a hit to Canada’s auto sector. Whether automakers continue to shift imports to non-U.S. markets will depend on how trade negotiations progress, said Ross. “If it were not to move (in a positive) direction, then I think we could continue to see that climb of market share for Mexico, for Japan specifically,” he said. “Whether or not that’s the best way forward, it’s a better way forward than having our skin in the game with a U.S. marketplace that’s highly volatile for the last few years.” --- Sammy Hudes, The Canadian Press This report by The Canadian Press was first published Nov. 25, 2026.

FAST

BRUSSELS, Nov 26 : Chinese e-commerce platform Temu has committed to bringing several of its commercial practices in line with EU consumer protection laws, the European Commission said on Thursday. "Temu's commitments concern a broad range of commercial practices that mislead consumers or unduly influence their purchasing decisions, including fake discounts, fake reviews, pressure selling, forced gamification, and missing and misleading information," the Commission said in a statement. Temu, which is owned by PDD Holdings, said it would provide clearer and more accessible information for customer support, prices, environmental claims and checkout, and would make refunds easier. Temu also committed to ending forced gamification features, like spinning the wheel to access the marketplace, and pressure-selling messages, the Commission said. A Temu spokesperson said the company was pleased to have reached a resolution. "We appreciate the constructive engagement throughout the process and will continue to strengthen transparency and improve the shopping experience for consumers across Europe." Countries will now monitor Temu's compliance with its commitments. Failing to comply could lead to fines of 4 per cent or more of Temu's annual turnover in the concerned member states.

Source: Reuters

item.title: Coal gasification scheme attracts just two bids in its third round
item.description: Limited participation in the third round highlights financing and technology challenges, with industry calling for credit guarantees and greater lender confidence to attract investment ...
item.dc:creator: Saket Kumar
item.content:encoded: With just two bids received in its third round, the Centre’s ₹37,500-crore coal gasification incentive scheme has continued to see limited industry participation, highlighting the challenges of attracting investment into a capital-intensive industry despite substantial government support. According to a notice issued by the Ministry of Coal, one bid each was received under Category 2, meant for private-sector companies and government public sector undertakings (PSUs), and Category 3, which covers demonstration projects using indigenous technology and/or small-scale product-based plants. Talcher Chemicals Private Limited, the sole bidder under Category 2, and Carbon Chemical Private Limited, the sole bidder under Category 3, have been declared technically qualified and made eligible to open their financial bids. The response follows seven applications in the first round and two in the second, both submitted by state-run NTPC. The limited participation across three rounds raises questions about what it will take to attract a wider pool of investors to India’s coal gasification sector. Coal gasification converts coal into synthesis gas, or syngas, which can be used to manufacture products such as methanol, ammonia, synthetic natural gas, hydrogen, fertilisers, and other chemicals. The scheme, approved by the Union Cabinet in May 2026, has an outlay of ₹37,500 crore and aims to support projects that gasify around 75 million tonnes of coal and lignite. It is intended to contribute towards India’s target of achieving 100 million tonnes of coal gasification capacity by 2030. The government expects the initiative to attract investments of ₹2.5-3 trillion and reduce dependence on high-value imported industrial feedstock. Atanu Mukherjee, chief executive officer of Dastur Energy, said the limited response should not necessarily be interpreted as a lack of industry interest, but rather as a reflection of the challenges in translating interest into commercially viable and financeable projects. Dastur Energy provides coal gasification consultancy to companies. “Viability Gap Funding (VGF) is an excellent mechanism for improving project economics and incentivising capital investment. However, improving project economics and making a project bankable are two different things,” Mukherjee said. Financial institutions remain cautious about lending to capital-intensive projects of this nature, particularly where domestic commercial operating precedents are limited, and technology and implementation risks are perceived to be high, Mukherjee said. Equity investors seek greater visibility on the availability and cost of debt, while lenders require certainty around technology performance, project execution and long-term commercial viability, he added. He said the government could complement the existing incentive framework with a partial credit guarantee mechanism to reduce lenders’ risks and encourage greater participation from financial institutions. Technology suited to India’s high-ash coal and the availability of assured buyers for the products are other important considerations for prospective investors, he said. Mukherjee suggested that India facilitate the licensing of proven international technologies, including suitable Chinese technologies, through domestic technology companies to build engineering, equipment manufacturing and execution capabilities. He also called for the development of standardised modular gasification systems processing around 500-1,500 tonnes of coal per day, depending on feedstock and industrial application. Such projects could widen participation beyond a handful of large industrial groups, while generating operating experience and improving confidence among lenders, he said. Long-term offtake arrangements with fertiliser, chemical, steel and energy companies could improve revenue visibility for projects. However, assured buyers alone would not ensure commercial viability, Mukherjee said, adding that coal-derived products would need to remain competitive with imported alternatives.

item.title: Bitcoin supera los US$60.000 en medio de un repunte de los activos de riesgo
item.description: La recuperación de las acciones tecnológicas dio un respiro al mercado de criptomonedas, aunque los analistas advierten que la debilidad de la demanda persiste.
item.dc:creator: Emily Nicolle
item.content:encoded: Bloomberg — El jueves, el bitcoin superó la marca de los US$60.000, impulsado por la recuperación de las acciones tecnológicas y el repunte de los activos de riesgo, lo que llevó al alza a los mercados de criptomonedas antes de un período de baja actividad comercial debido a las fiestas navideñas. La criptomoneda más grande subió hasta un 2,2% durante la sesión asiática antes de moderar parte de esas ganancias, cotizando a alrededor de US$60.400 en las primeras horas de la mañana en Nueva York. Otros tokens, como Ether y XRP, también registraron alzas. Ver más: ETF de bitcoin en EE.UU. se encaminan a su peor mes con salidas cercanas a US$5.000 millones Bitcoin ha perdido más de una quinta parte de su valor este mes, lo que lo encamina a su mayor caída mensual desde el colapso del mercado de criptomonedas hace más de cuatro años. El sector ha tenido dificultades para recuperar la confianza de los inversores en medio de una serie de ciberataques de alto perfil, una creciente presión macroeconómica y la incertidumbre regulatoria tras las elecciones de mitad de mandato en Estados Unidos. “El repunte ha mejorado el panorama”, escribieron los analistas de Marex en una nota el jueves. “Pero no ha corregido la situación subyacente de la demanda”. Ver más: Millonarios del bitcoin se interesan por estas islas del Caribe y países de América Latina para migrar Un conjunto de fondos cotizados en bolsa estadounidenses que siguen el precio del bitcoin registraron salidas de capital por valor de US$453 millones el miércoles, lo que eleva las salidas totales del grupo en el último mes a más de US$5.000 millones. Estos productos se lanzaron con gran bombo y platillo en enero de 2024, pero su rendimiento se ha visto afectado por la menor demanda del activo subyacente. “Dado que la venta de ETF sigue a un ritmo acelerado, es posible que bitcoin haya encontrado un respiro a corto plazo, pero existe un riesgo real de que los vendedores regresen una vez que se calmen las aguas tras las fiestas, dejando de nuevo a la vista los mínimos recientes”, dijo Axel Rudolph, analista técnico jefe de IG. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

item.title: セルビア、12月27日に大統領選 10月議会選は学生主導勢力勝利
item.description: ［ベオグラード ２６日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［ベオグラード　２６日　ロイター］ - セルビア議会のチュピッチ議長は２６日、１２月２７日に大統領選を実施すると発表した。

ブチッチ前大統領は、１０月２５日の議会選に首相候補として出馬するため９月２７日に辞任した。しかし、汚職撲滅を訴える学生主導の新興政治勢力が擁立した候補者に大敗を喫した。

チュピッチ氏は選挙期日を定める文書に署名した上で、「全てのセルビア国民に対し、責任を示して１２月２７日に投票に行くよう呼びかける」と述べた。

大統領職は儀礼的な役割が中心で、法的な権限は比較的小さい。大統領は各政党との協議を経て首相指名候補を提案する。また、軍幹部の任命や解任を行うほか、政府の要請に基づいて議会を解散することができる。

item.title: NADBank prepara línea de crédito para CFE destinada a fondear múltiples proyectos de energía
item.description: John Beckham, director general de NADBank, dijo que el mercado se está adaptando al nuevo marco regulatorio normativo de México para invertir en energía.
item.dc:creator: Zenyazen Flores
item.content:encoded: Ciudad de México — El Banco de Desarrollo de América del Norte (NADBank) prepara una línea de crédito para fondear múltiples proyectos de energía de la empresa estatal mexicana Comisión Federal de Electricidad (CFE), la cual será anunciada pronto, dijo a Bloomberg Línea su director general, John Beckham. Beckham refirió que en 2027 se dará continuidad a la agenda de infraestructura de este año, por lo que sus prioridades serán proyectos de saneamiento, distribución, conservación y uso eficiente del agua en la región, así como temas de demanda de generación y transmisión eléctrica que “siguen fuertísimos”. Ver más: CFE Fibra E realiza nueva emisión de capital por US$776 millones para financiar redes eléctricas de México Tras señalar que el mercado se está adaptando al nuevo marco regulatorio normativo de México para invertir en energía, el directivo adelantó que se va a publicar pronto una “operación grande” con la CFE y vaticinó que en 2027 habrá más noticias en el tema de generación. “Es una línea de crédito que pudiera fondear múltiple variedad de proyectos de transmisión, generación, distribución y la generación puede ser entre gas natural y renovables. Ahí realmente va a ser el criterio de CFE, bajo un marco que estamos estableciendo con ellos”, señaló. El director general de NADBank, una institución financiera de colaboración binacional entre México y Estados Unidos para el desarrollo de infraestructura en la región fronteriza, matizó que, si bien el banco tiene un pie fuerte en las energías renovables, también puede contemplar e incluir el gas natural. Cuestionado sobre el momento del anuncio de la línea de crédito, Beckham comentó que podría ser en el cierre de año, o bien, hacia el primer trimestre del 2027. El directivo no ofreció mayores detalles sobre el monto del crédito al ser una operación en marcha. Ver más: Banca de México trabaja en financiar proyectos mixtos de CFE con empresas privadas El documento “Propuesta de Certificación y Financiamiento, Infraestructura energética para la CFE en la frontera norte de México”, publicado el 18 de septiembre de 2026 en el sitio web de NADBank, subraya que la CFE prevé inversiones por US$37.526 millones, la mayoría en la región norte de México, incluyendo áreas dentro de la jurisdicción del Banco. Según la Secretaría de Energía de México, más del 60% de la nueva capacidad de generación prevista hasta 2039 se ubicará en esa región. En ese sentido, el documento señala que, para apoyar el programa de inversión de la CFE en la región fronteriza, NADBank propuso otorgar a la Comisión hasta US$200 millones en financiamiento para proyectos elegibles de generación, transmisión y distribución que mejoren el desempeño ambiental y la confiabilidad de la red eléctrica. Si bien el financiamiento del NADBank podría asignarse a una cartera diversa de activos elegibles, el banco ha identificado la Central de Combustión Interna (CCI) Parque Industrial, ubicada en San Luis Río Colorado, como el proyecto prioritario para recibir financiamiento. Esta planta de 200 megawatts inició operaciones comerciales en marzo de 2025 y aporta capacidad de respuesta rápida para atender los picos de demanda en Baja California y partes de Sonora. Ver más: CFE todavía analiza proyectos mixtos de generación eléctrica con empresas privadas CFE, la empresa eléctrica más grande de Latinoamérica con 70 GigaWatts de capacidad de generación instalada, ha obtenido en el último año dos líneas de crédito con organismos multilaterales para financiar sus planes de expansión de generación eléctrica. En diciembre de 2025 obtuvo crédito por US$300 millones del Banco de Desarrollo de América Latina y el Caribe (CAF) para financiar redes eléctricas en México y en junio de este año obtuvo una línea de crédito del Banco Centroamericano de Integración Económica por US$500 millones para financiar centrales eléctricas de gas natural. En tanto, el NADBank anunció en octubre el lanzamiento del Programa de Acceso a Financiamiento (PAFi), una nueva herramienta que permitirá ampliar el acceso a financiamiento a través de intermediarios financieros calificados para proyectos ambientales en la región fronteriza entre México y Estados Unidos. El programa contará con una asignación de hasta US$300 millones, para ser dispersados en varias instituciones financieras tanto públicas como privadas. “En el área de proyectos medianos, que son exclusivamente con el sector privado y que vamos a canalizar a través de lo que llamamos el PAFi, son principalmente proyectos de US$5 millones de tamaño para abajo, vamos a canalizar a través de bancos intermediarios financieros”, comentó Beckham. Ver más: CFE dependerá del sector privado para financiar la mayoría de sus inversiones con Sheinbaum El expresidente mexicano, Andrés Manuel López Obrador, aplicó una política de restringir la participación del sector privado en CFE, por lo que llevó a cabo cambios controversiales a la Ley de la Industria Eléctrica y otras regulaciones que generaron incertidumbre entre los privados. La presidenta Claudia Sheinbaum tiene un ambicioso plan de infraestructura con proyectos de energía que abarcan una parte mayoritaria, para los cual ha abierto la puerta al sector privado mediante contratos mixtos y otros instrumentos financieros que ayudarán a la CFE a financiar sus inversiones. Además, la Secretaría de Hacienda trabaja en un esquema de financiamiento tipo umbrella financing para proyectos de energía renovable.

FAST

PARIS, Nov 26 : FIFA said on Thursday it had been the victim of a criminal cyberattack that gave unauthorised access to personal and business information. A person with direct knowledge of the matter told Reuters that no files from the abandoned FIFA Forward Enterprise project were accessed. "FIFA can confirm that it has been the victim of a criminal cyberattack resulting in unauthorised access to a limited set of personal and business information," a FIFA spokesperson told Reuters. FIFA strongly condemned the unlawful acquisition and publication of information, particularly personal data, adding that such actions were "a serious and unacceptable violation of privacy".

FIFA did not say how many people or organisations were affected, when the attack took place or what the business information included. Its reference to publication did not say whether any data had appeared online, or where. The person with knowledge of the matter said less than 0.1 per cent of the total data held by world soccer's ruling body was affected. FIFA President Gianni Infantino said in July that his organisation had scrapped plans to sell a stake in the World Cup to private investors following a widespread backlash. The plan had been to raise up to $4.2 billion by selling a 20 per cent stake in a new unit that would run FIFA events, including the World Cup.

item.title: Ahorrar, gastar menos y desendeudarse: el mensaje de Olga Lucía Acosta a los colombianos para 2027
item.description: La codirectora del Banco de la República advierte que el ajuste económico podría tomar varios años, explica los riesgos que enfrenta el país y anticipa cuándo podrían comenzar a bajar las tasas de int ...
item.dc:creator: Daniel Guerrero
item.content:encoded: Bogotá — Los hogares colombianos tendrán que moderar su consumo, aumentar sus ahorros y, en algunos casos, reducir su endeudamiento como parte del ajuste que necesita la economía del país para recuperar la estabilidad y retomar un crecimiento sostenible , asegura Olga Lucía Acosta, codirectora del Banco de la República. “El ajuste es algo que nos va a pasar a todos y que lo requerimos para que podamos crecer más”, dijo en una entrevista con Bloomberg Línea. La economista considera que 2027 será un año de estabilización, en el que Colombia no podrá esperar un elevado crecimiento económico debido a que no ha cuidado las fuentes que lo sustentan. Las proyecciones del equipo técnico del banco central apuntan a una expansión de la economía ligeramente inferior al 2% para el próximo año, por debajo de la que se alcanzaría en 2026. Una de las preocupaciones de Acosta es la prolongación del dinamismo del consumo de los hogares, que comenzó tras la pandemia y se ha mantenido gracias a distintas fuentes de ingresos. Los buenos precios del café, el turismo y las remesas han contribuido a mejorar los ingresos de las familias colombianas, pero esos recursos no se han traducido en un mayor ahorro. “Tenemos un boom de consumo que no ha parado”, señaló la codirectora. El problema, según explicó, es que los colombianos han consumido más allá de la capacidad productiva de la economía, una situación que ha generado presiones inflacionarias que el Banco de la República busca controlar. De cara a 2027, Acosta considera necesario que los hogares moderen su ritmo de gasto y que quienes tengan capacidad de ahorro destinen una mayor proporción de sus ingresos a ese propósito. También plantea la necesidad de que aquellos que están endeudados reduzcan sus obligaciones financieras. “Si no hacemos bien ese ajuste no vamos a poder crecer”, advirtió. La codirectora del Banco de la República explicó que Colombia arrastra desde hace varios años un desequilibrio entre sus ingresos y sus gastos, un problema estructural que ningún Gobierno ha conseguido resolver. “Estamos gastando mucho más de lo que somos capaces de generar”, sostuvo Acosta, quien considera que durante la anterior administración se acentuó ese desequilibrio. La economista ve en la Ley de Rescate que impulsa el Gobierno una oportunidad para enviar una señal sobre el compromiso del país con la recuperación de la sostenibilidad de sus finanzas públicas. Sin embargo, considera que el esfuerzo deberá extenderse durante 2027 y 2028 para conseguir resultados en materia de sostenibilidad de la deuda pública. Una de las prioridades, explicó, será conseguir que la deuda deje de crecer para posteriormente reducirla cuando las condiciones económicas sean más favorables. “No es inmediato el ajuste, va a durar por varios periodos”, aseguró. Acosta también reconoció las dificultades que ha tenido el banco central para transmitir la magnitud del problema fiscal a los colombianos y a quienes tienen la responsabilidad de tomar decisiones. “Yo siento algo de frustración”, manifestó al referirse a los esfuerzos por comunicar la gravedad de la situación de las finanzas públicas y la urgencia de resolverla. En medio de los esfuerzos de estabilización económica, Acosta considera que un incremento del salario mínimo cercano al 8% para 2027 permitiría remunerar a los trabajadores en un año que anticipa difícil para la economía. Su planteamiento parte de una inflación que cerraría 2026, según señaló, a lo sumo en 7%, y de un incremento de la productividad que podría rondar el 1%. La codirectora reconoció que el aumento del 23% del salario mínimo para 2026 fue favorable individualmente para las familias que reciben esa remuneración, pero recordó las dificultades que enfrentaron algunas empresas para asumirlo. Los estudios del Banco de la República, explicó, muestran un mayor deterioro del empleo formal en los sectores intensivos en mano de obra y con una mayor proporción de sus nóminas vinculadas al salario mínimo. Acosta recordó que el 70% del empleo en Colombia es generado por pequeñas y medianas empresas, algunas de las cuales no pudieron asumir el incremento salarial, que además estuvo acompañado de mayores costos derivados de la reforma laboral. Pese a la perspectiva de un menor crecimiento económico, Acosta defendió la necesidad de mantener una política monetaria que permita recuperar la estabilidad de los precios y preservar el poder adquisitivo de los colombianos. “A nosotros no nos gusta tener que subir las tasas”, aseguró. La codirectora explicó que las decisiones de la Junta Directiva buscan preservar el poder adquisitivo de la moneda con el menor costo posible en materia de crecimiento económico y generación de empleo. No obstante, encuentra motivos para el optimismo en los primeros pasos del Gobierno para acompañar los esfuerzos de estabilización económica mediante un ajuste fiscal sostenible y creíble. “A la política monetaria le tocó en los últimos años navegar un poco sola”, recordó. Una mayor coordinación entre las políticas fiscal y monetaria podría acelerar los resultados y permitir que, durante el segundo semestre de 2027, comience un proceso sostenible de reducción de las tasas de interés. Esa posibilidad, según Acosta, dependerá de las señales que entregue l a economía y de los resultados de una política monetaria cuyos efectos pueden tardar entre seis meses y un año en materializarse. “Nos toca a veces apretar los dientes y esperar que se dé ese resultado”, concluyó.

item.title: ホルムズ海峡でタンカー2隻爆発・炎上、未承認航路航行とイラン革命防衛隊
item.description: ［ドバイ ２６日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［ドバイ　２６日　ロイター］ - イランの精鋭部隊、イスラム革命防衛隊は２６日、オマーンのハサブ港北方で、未承認の航路を通ってホルムズ海峡を通過しようとしたタンカー２隻が機雷に接触し、爆発・炎上したと発表した。うち１隻は原油２００万バレル以上を積載した大型タンカーだったとしている。半国営タスニム通信が伝えた。

英海事機関（ＵＫＭＴＯ）は同日、ドバイの西約５０カイリ沖のタンカー付近で、未確認の飛翔体による爆発があったと報告した。

イラン国営メディアによると、革命防衛隊の報道官は、米経済に圧力をかけ、イランを防衛するために、同海峡の封鎖を維持すべく強力な火力を行使していると述べた。

革命防衛隊海軍司令官も、イランがホルムズ海峡を完全に作戦統制下に置いており、安全な通航はイランの正当な主権への尊重にかかっていると述べた。

item.description: AMSTERDAM, Nov 26 : Dutch consumer and digital rights groups asked a court on Thursday to halt sales of Meta AI-powered smart glasses in the Netherlands, arguing they violate European privacy laws by allowing wearers to film people without their knowledge.While limited in scope to the Netherlands, a summary r

Dutch groups ask court to halt Meta smart glasses sales over privacy concerns

FILE PHOTO: The updated Meta smart glasses are seen during the Meta Connect event at the company's headquarters in Menlo Park, California, U.S., September 27, 2023. REUTERS/Carlos Barria/File Photo

FAST

AMSTERDAM, Nov 26 : Dutch consumer and digital rights groups asked a court on Thursday to halt sales of Meta AI-powered smart glasses in the Netherlands, arguing they violate European privacy laws by allowing wearers to film people without their knowledge. While limited in scope to the Netherlands, a summary ruling in the civil suit against Meta at the Amsterdam District Court could set a precedent amid growing public backlash, venue bans and regulatory warnings across the world. The groups, which include the Netherlands' main consumer association Consumentenbond and Offlimits, which campaigns against online sex abuse, argued that the glasses developed by Meta and Ray-Ban owner EssilorLuxottica both violate privacy laws and force people to constantly worry in public places, with a chilling effect on society. The plaintiffs want Meta to prevent its glasses from being used to record people without their knowledge, stop using recordings to train AI models and halt sales until Meta complies. They sought penalties of €100,000 ($109,600) per day per defendant for non-compliance, capped at €100 million.

Offlimits' lawyer Karlijn Han said the glasses were used for what she described in court as "creep shots." "Covert recordings are undoubtedly also being made during exams, in changing rooms, at swimming pools, in hotel rooms and hospitals, but also in playgrounds and on beaches," she said in opening remarks. "Each invasion of privacy is worse than the last." META DENIES IMAGES ARE USED TO TRAIN AI Meta's lawyer Bastiaan Kemp said the court should reject the suit. He said the measures demanded would harm legitimate users, damage Meta's competitive position and amount to a product recall without resolving concerns about similar devices. “Providers of products cannot be held responsible for every instance of deliberate misuse,” he told the court. He said that a recording light on the frame makes it obvious when they are being used for recording. And he denied allegations made by Consumentenbond's lawyer in court that Meta processes images recorded by the smart glasses in Europe or uses them to train AI models in violation of European law. Meta and manufacturing partner EssilorLuxottica sold more than 7 million smart glasses in 2025, around 80 per cent of the global market. A lawyer for EssilorLuxottica argued that it neither processes nor has access to footage and that a sales ban would be disproportionate and ineffective given the availability of similar products from other manufacturers. BACKLASH EXTENDS WORLDWIDE From proposed restrictions in Australia and Norway to bans in courts across England, Wales and New York state, governments and judicial authorities are increasingly seeking to prevent covert recording and protect sensitive information. Cinema operators in the UK are also introducing restrictions over privacy and film piracy concerns.   On Tuesday, Germany's national consumer federation announced legal action against Meta and Ray-Ban over alleged privacy violations, arguing that the glasses make it nearly impossible for consumers to comply with European data protection rules when using them in public. The European Data Protection Board warned in October that smart glasses raised serious privacy concerns and called for stronger safeguards. Dutch privacy regulator AP this month advised consumers to not buy smart glasses, saying they are unsafe for both users and bystanders. In October, Dutch retail chain Hans Anders suspended sales of Meta's Ray-Ban smart glasses in the Netherlands and Belgium. Meta also faces proposed class-action lawsuits in the United States over alleged improper sharing of private images gathered by the glasses. A date for a decision in the Dutch case has not yet been set but is expected in mid-December. ($1 = 0.9124 euros)

Source: Reuters

BOLOGNA, Italy, Nov 26 : Britain's Cameron Norrie beat German Jan-Lennard Struff 6-3 3-6 6-2 to put his team 1-0 up in their Davis Cup quarter-final on Thursday. Britain are bidding to win the premier international men's team competition for the first time since 2015, while Germany are chasing their first title since 1993. Norrie broke Struff for a 3-1 lead before cruising through the opening set. Struff hit back in the second, however, breaking his opponent for the first time to force a decider. World number 52 Norrie regained control in the third set, breaking the 39th-ranked Struff for a 4-2 advantage before sealing victory in one hour 33 minutes.

item.title: Así cierra el ranking de salarios mínimos en Latinoamérica este 2026
item.description: Bloomberg Línea hace una recopilación de los salarios mínimos de América Latina al cierre de este 2026 tras las últimas actualizaciones.
item.dc:creator: Daniel Salazar Castellanos
item.content:encoded: Bloomberg Línea — Costa Rica y Panamá tienen los salarios mínimos más altos de América Latina al cierre de 2026, con remuneraciones mensuales equivalentes a US$841 y US$706, respectivamente, según los datos recopilados para las principales economías de la región por Bloomberg Línea. En Sudamérica, los salarios mínimos más altos se registran en economías como Uruguay, con unos US$626, y Chile, con unos US$531. Ver más: Salario mínimo de 2027: los países de América Latina con menor y mayor margen para subirlo Entre tanto, las economías más grandes de América Latina quedan más rezagadas y presentan brechas entre sí. En Brasil, el salario mínimo actual se estima en US$276, mientras que en México se ubica en US$485. En el extremo opuesto, Venezuela y Cuba registran los ingresos mínimos más bajos, con valores inferiores a US$4 mensuales. Argentina, Chile, Paraguay, Uruguay y otras economías de Centroamérica y el Caribe aumentaron el salario mínimo en el transcurso de 2026, en un delicado equilibrio entre proteger los ingresos de los hogares y contener las presiones inflacionarias. Los ajustes responden a los calendarios y mecanismos de negociación de cada país, que revisan periódicamente las remuneraciones con base en las condiciones económicas, el costo de vida y las necesidades de los trabajadores. Por ello, las fechas y magnitudes de los incrementos varían entre las economías latinoamericanas. Ver más: Estos son los países con mayor índice de hambre en Latinoamérica en 2026: Haití se acerca a nivel “alarmante” La brecha entre países también refleja las diferencias en sus estructuras económicas y en el poder adquisitivo de sus monedas. La doctora en Economía y profesora de la Universidad del Rosario en Colombia, Clara Inés Pardo, ha explicado a Bloomberg Línea que “los salarios mínimos por sí solos están, en casi toda la región, por debajo de lo necesario para cubrir una canasta básica (alimentos, vivienda, transporte)”. Venezuela es uno de los casos más críticos en la región. Una familia de cinco personas en Venezuela necesitó en octubre US$744,55 para gastos de alimentación, pese a que el salario mínimo es de apenas US$0,14, según el Centro de Documentación y Análisis Social (Cendas) de la Federación de Maestros. Ver más: Los 10 países con mayor productividad laboral por hora en América Latina y el Caribe En América Latina, “las brechas se explican por la combinación de nivel de desarrollo económico, inflación, tipo de cambio, estructuras tributarias y grado de formalización laboral”, indicó la académica. Pero en los países con mayores ingresos en América Latina tampoco está garantizado un alto poder adquisitivo si los precios de vivienda, transporte y alimentos son elevados. En países de menor ingreso, los salarios son más bajos, pero “usualmente también lo es el costo de vida (aunque no siempre proporcionalmente)”. Se incluyen las principales economías de Latinoamérica con los últimos datos disponibles y se organizan por orden alfabético. Fuente: Información oficial de cada país / Bloomberg Línea. Tasa de cambio al: 25/11/2026. Los países con variación 0,0% no realizaron cambios recientes. En El Salvador, Guatemala, Nicaragua, Honduras, Panamá y República Dominicana existen varios tipos de salarios mínimos dependiendo del sector y el tamaño de la empresa. Mientras Costa Rica, Panamá y Uruguay se ubican entre los países con los salarios mínimos nominales más altos, Venezuela, Cuba, Argentina y Nicaragua aparecen en el extremo inferior de la clasificación, al convertir sus remuneraciones a dólares estadounidenses. Ver más: Del crecimiento económico al precio del dólar: las proyecciones de Citi para Latinoamérica en 2026 y 2027 Los salarios mínimos en América Latina también se ven presionados por el aumento del costo de vida en los países ante los efectos de la guerra en Medio Oriente en los precios de la energía. En la región, la volatilidad de los precios de la energía durante 2026 ha añadido presiones inflacionarias. En octubre, varias de las principales economías de la región registraron tasas de inflación por encima de los rangos de tolerancia establecidos por sus bancos centrales. Estas son las tasas de inflación interanual reportadas para las economías de América Latina, principalmente con datos de octubre de 2026. *Cifras oficiales consultadas por Bloomberg Línea. En diciembre de 2025, la mediana de la inflación anual se situó en el 3,1% en América Latina y el Caribe. Por subregiones, alcanzó el 4% en Sudamérica, el 2,4% en Centroamérica y el 1,4% en el Caribe, según información de la Comisión Económica para América Latina y el Caribe (Cepal). En mayo de 2026, la mediana de la inflación regional aún estaba en el 3,1%. En este contexto, “el crecimiento proyectado del PIB regional para 2026 (2,2%) sería insuficiente para elevar de manera sostenida el ingreso por habitante”, advirtió la Cepal en su informe Panorama Social de América Latina y el Caribe 2026. Las negociaciones del salario mínimo para 2027 en América Latina deberán compensar la pérdida de poder adquisitivo sin alimentar una nueva ola inflacionaria, en un escenario de mayores precios de la energía, tasas de interés elevadas y poco margen para impulsar aumentos reales , dijeron analistas consultados por Bloomberg Línea para un reciente informe. “Los gobiernos tendrán que equilibrar dos objetivos: proteger el poder adquisitivo de los trabajadores, que se ha erosionado este año, y no alimentar nuevas presiones sobre los precios en un contexto en que los bancos centrales siguen atentos a la inflación”, dijo en una reciente entrevista a este medio Nicolás Cruz, analista de investigaciones económicas de la corporación financiera Corficolombiana. Por eso, ve probable que las decisiones “se apoyen más en criterios técnicos, como la inflación esperada y la productividad, y en el diálogo entre gobiernos, empresarios y trabajadores”. Según el analista de Corficolombiana, Colombia está entre los países que enfrentarán un panorama más desafiante con una inflación del 6,3% interanual en octubre. Asimismo, considera que las discusiones sobre el salario mínimo del 2027 serán especialmente sensibles en Brasil (con una inflación del 4,63% interanual en octubre por encima del techo de su meta). Y a pesar de que ya han definido su esquema de ajustes, países como Argentina (con una inflación interanual de 33,1% en octubre) y Perú (5,25%, su mayor nivel desde 2023) también enfrentan presiones hacia el futuro. Ver más: La inflación vuelve a presionar a América Latina: así cerró octubre 2026, país por país

item.title: ロシア、ウクライナが地中海やバルト海へ戦争拡大と非難 - Reuters

item.title: ロシア、ウクライナが地中海やバルト海へ戦争拡大と非難
item.description: [モスクワ ２６日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[モスクワ ２６日 ロイター] - ロシア大統領府のペスコフ報道官は２６日、ウクライナが対ロ戦争を地中海とバルト海に拡大しようとしていると非難し、極めて危険な動きだと警告した。

トランプ米大統領と北大西洋条約機構（ＮＡＴＯ）のルッテ事務総長は２５日、米フロリダ州での会談後に共同声明を発表し、ウクライナでの戦争を拡大させる行動を避けるようロシアに求めた。ウクライナが最近、紛争地域から遠く離れたロシアの権益を攻撃したことを巡り、報復措置を慎重に検討するようロシアに警告したものとみられる。

ウクライナは２２日、リビアの港湾で水上無人艇（ドローン）を使ってロシア海軍のコルベット艦を撃沈した。前日にはフィンランド湾でロシア軍関連の貨物船をドローンで攻撃していた。

ペスコフ氏は電話会見で米・ＮＡＴＯの共同声明について「ウクライナ紛争の激化に関しては、ウクライナ政権が紛争の地理的範囲を拡大しようとしていることを指すようだ。われわれは地中海とバルト海でウクライナ政権によるテロ活動を目撃している」と述べた。

「これは沿岸諸国だけでなく、おそらくＮＡＴＯ内部でも懸念を引き起こさざるを得ない。むろん紛争の地理的拡大は誰も望まないだろう。ウクライナ政権による潜在的に極めて危険な行動だ」と語った。

FAST

HONG KONG, Nov 26 : Standard Chartered's cryptocurrency custody unit Zodia Custody suffered a security breach earlier this week that exposed some client and employee information, the unit's chief executive told Reuters on Thursday. The breach, detected by Zodia on Monday, resulted in some client and staff data, including names and email addresses, being leaked, Zodia Custody CEO Richard Clark said in an emailed statement. The company's London-listed shares were up 2.6 per cent on the day. "Based on our investigation to date, there have been no unauthorised transactions," Clark said.

The incident is a setback for the Asia- and Africa-focused lender's digital asset ambitions, coming weeks after it increased its stake in Zodia to 100 per cent as it expands its cryptocurrency business amid growing mainstream adoption of digital assets. Zodia on Monday took offline software that allows institutional clients' systems to connect directly to its platform after detecting what Clark described as attempts to probe its systems. The service has since been restored, and affected clients and regulators have been notified, he added. On Tuesday, Zodia determined that an unauthorised party had accessed "limited" client information, including organisation details and, for a small number of clients and employees, a business contact name and email address, Clark said. The breach adds to a growing list of cybersecurity incidents affecting financial institutions as hackers deploy increasingly sophisticated tools, although it is not clear whether artificial intelligence played any role in this case.

BANGKOK, Nov 26 : Thailand's Bangchak Corp said on Thursday it had shut all production units at its Phra Khanong oil refinery in Bangkok following a fire. • The fire broke out at around 2:45 p.m. (0745 GMT) and was brought under control and extinguished around 30 minutes later, the company said • Nine personnel sustained injuries, two of whom have returned home, Bangchak Corp said in a later statement • The cause of the incident at the refinery, which has a maximum capacity of 120,000 barrels per day, is under investigation

item.title: 仏極右党首に新たな反ユダヤ疑惑報道、10代の頃のチャット巡り
item.description: [パリ ２６日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[パリ ２６日 ロイター] - 仏極右政党、国民連合（ＲＮ）のジョルダン・バルデラ党首（３１）は２６日、過去の反ユダヤ主義的なコメントを巡って新たな非難に直面した。同党首が１０代だった２０１３年にチャットで交わしたとされる新たな一連の記録が報じられた。

バルデラ氏を巡る最初の疑惑は、９月に調査報道メディア「メディアパート」によって伝えられた。同メディアは、同氏が数多くの反ユダヤ主義的かつ陰謀論的なコメントを行っていたと報じていた。

来年の大統領選挙を控え、ＲＮを事実上率いるマリーヌ・ルペン氏は世論調査で首位を走っており、同氏が当選した場合、バルデラ氏は首相に就任すると見込まれている。

メディアパートと仏紙ルモンドは２６日、チャットの情報源に再取材を行ったと報道。その情報源から提供された完全な記録によると、これらのチャットには反ユダヤ主義的かつ陰謀論的な内容が散見される。

ロイターはこれらの記録を独自に検証できていない。

ルモンドは、フェイスブックの親会社であるメタを通じてチャットの真正性を確認し、情報源の身元も確認したとしている。

バルデラ氏は「メディアパートとルモンドが私のものとしているチャット内容について、断固として否定することを改めて表明する」との声明を出し、自身が未成年だった頃の出来事を報じようとしている両メディアを批判。「これらの内容は、当時も今も、私の考えでも、価値観でも、信念でもない」と訴えた。

item.title: 英、原潜施設改修でバブコックと80億ポンド契約 即応態勢強化
item.description:
Sarah Young
[ロンドン ２６日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Sarah Young

[ロンドン ２６日 ロイター] - 英国は原子力潜水艦関連施設の改修に向け、防衛企業バブコックと８０億ポンド（１０４億８０００万ドル）の契約を結んだ。ストリーティング国防相は２６日、英国の「戦闘即応態勢」を整える取り組みの一環だと説明した。

政府は過去２年間、国防費の積み増しに必要な財源の確保に苦慮してきた。ストリーティング氏はその状況が変わりつつあるとし、先月発表された財務相の予算案で国防分野が「際立った勝者」になったと述べた。

声明で「われわれの原子力潜水艦は国家安全保障の礎だ」と強調した。「他省庁から財源を移すことになっても、核抑止力と英国の戦闘即応態勢の確立を優先する」とした。

ストリーティング氏は、政府が戦略予備役である退役軍人約１０万人にも連絡を取り、情報を最新の状態に更新させるとともに、戦争に備えるよう伝えたと明らかにした。

バーナム首相は、今回の潜水艦契約によりプリマス、クライド、ブリストルを中心に５５００人の新規雇用が生まれ、国内各地の成長を押し上げると述べた。

HONG KONG, Nov 26 : Malaysian convenience retailer KK Mart Retail launched an initial public offering on Thursday worth up to 462 million ringgit ($112.3 million), according to its IPO prospectus. • It expects to raise 115.5 million ringgit from the sale of 210 million new shares. It will use the money for store expansion, distribution centres and technology upgrades • Selling shareholders K8 Resources and Arus Sejahtera are offering up to 630 million existing shares, which could fetch 346.5 million ringgit at the retail price of 55 sen per share • KK Mart, which operates 1,106 stores nationwide, plans to list on the domestic bourse on December 15

Malaysia wants priority over other lenders if it backs AirAsia

AirAsia is aiming to raise up to US$1 billion from international debt markets, as well as 700 million ringgit in local credit facilities.

FILE PHOTO: An AirAsia plane takes off at Kuala Lumpur International Airport Terminal 2 (KLIA2) in Sepang, Malaysia, September 18, 2026. REUTERS/Najjua Zulkefli/File Photo

26 Nov 2026 06:19PM

FAST

KUALA LUMPUR: Malaysia will require AirAsia to give it priority over other lenders if the government agrees to provide support to the budget airline, the country's finance minister said on Thursday (Nov 26). Officials have said they are assessing ways to provide support without risking public funds. Authorities are monitoring AirAsia's financial health as airlines around the world grapple with a jump in jet fuel prices linked to the Iran war. AirAsia has said it was aiming to raise up to US$1 billion from international debt markets as well as 700 million ringgit in local credit facilities, with the fundraising expected to be completed between December and February. Shares in the airline, which controls about 60 per cent of Malaysia's domestic aviation market and employs about 26,000 people, have lost about 72 per cent of their value this year. AirAsia posted a narrower loss in the third quarter, but warned of rising fuel costs as it works to boost liquidity.

Malaysia's Second Finance Minister Amir Hamzah Azizan told parliament that there has so far been no agreement or commitment to provide support to AirAsia, either in the form of loans, guarantees or public fund injections. But if required, the government would look to safeguard public funds and ensure no disruptions to connectivity, he added. "We want to ensure that public funds get the priority they deserve because we would be the saviours if we were to intervene," Amir Hamzah said. The government would also look to strengthen oversight of AirAsia's board and management, Amir Hamzah said, citing a similar approach taken to assist debt-laden oil and gas services firm Vantris Energy. "The government's priority is the interests of the nation and the people, not the interests of shareholders," he added. The government's monitoring was only focused on AirAsia's domestic operations and not on its overseas arms or related businesses under its affiliate Capital A. Malaysia last year approved a 1.1 billion ringgit (US$267 million) capital injection into Vantris through redeemable convertible loan stock, a move officials have described as a strategic ecosystem rescue rather than a bailout. The global aviation industry is suffering its worst crisis since the COVID-19 pandemic as the conflict, which began at the end of February, disrupts operations, drives up fuel prices, and sends airlines' costs rocketing. Norwegian airline Norse Atlantic suspended flights on Thursday and intends to file for bankruptcy if it cannot secure a short-term financing solution urgently.

Source: Reuters/nh

Nov 26 : Min Woo Lee left his eight-iron in Las Vegas after giving two Formula One stars a golf lesson, but still managed to shoot a four-under-par 68 in the Australian PGA Championship first round on Thursday. The Australian said the club, mislaid after a lesson with Carlos Sainz and Lance Stroll at last week's Las Vegas Grand Prix, had been located and was now in Sydney. "I was with Carlos Sainz and Lance Stroll and I was giving them a lesson and I think they were just touching the clubs and it's gone somewhere," the 28-year-old said. "Maybe they might have used it in the race. I'm not sure."

"I needed it a few times today but it's actually a really fun way to play golf: it's either a nine-iron and I've got to hit it harder or add some spin with a seven-iron," he added. Lee was tied 11th after the opening round at The Lakes golf club, four strokes behind surprise leader and compatriot Haydn Barron.

FAST

LONDON, Nov 26 : Premier League leaders Arsenal have stumbled since the international break, but Manchester City's problems run far deeper ahead of Sunday's meeting between two teams who have been at the heart of recent Premier League title races. Arsenal's 2-2 draw at Newcastle United last weekend was followed by a midweek stalemate at home to Borussia Dortmund in the Champions League. The slight dip has left manager Mikel Arteta with plenty to ponder but the truth is his side remain six points clear in the Premier League and comfortably placed in Europe. City, on the other hand, go to north London on Sunday on the back of three defeats and a draw in the Premier League and Tuesday's home draw with Napoli in the Champions League was hardly the sort of confidence boost required.

For Arteta's Arsenal, the biggest problem has been efficiency in attack. They registered plenty of possession and territory against Newcastle and Dortmund, but lacked a clinical edge. It was especially apparent against Dortmund with 30 goal attempts but only four on target. City's recent slump has exposed far wider issues. Their porous defence has gone 10 games without a clean sheet in all competitions, the midfield control and invention that were the trademark of former manager Pep Guardiola's side have vanished and even striker Erling Haaland looks becalmed. "When you do not win you start to question everything," Haaland said after Tuesday's draw with Napoli - a comment that summed up the current fragility. All of that too against a backdrop of uncertainty after an independent commission in September found City guilty of 114 breaches of the Premier League's financial rules. The club are appealing the verdict and have denied wrongdoing. City's slump, after winning their opening seven league games, has dampened the early mood of defiance at the club and the atmosphere has been flat at the Etihad Stadium. Defeat on Sunday would leave City nine points adrift of Arsenal and while the season is still young, such a deficit would leave them facing a bleak winter. Maresca, who is beginning to come under intense scrutiny, will view Sunday's game as a chance to reignite City's season and a win would cut the gap to Arsenal to a manageable three points ahead of a full round of midweek fixtures. "It might be the day that City wake up," former Arsenal forward Thierry Henry said in midweek. "But if they play the same way they've been playing recently, being open and all over the place in midfield, it could be a long day." Before Arsenal and City lock horns on Sunday there is the small matter of the Merseyside derby. Liverpool are in fourth place with 21 points from their 11 games, seven points behind Arsenal, but there are signs that new manager Andoni Iraola is beginning to make them tick. Last week's 4-0 hammering of a woeful Manchester United followed an away win at Crystal Palace with Florian Wirtz scoring in both games - further signs that the German is starting to make the impact expected when he signed from Bayer Leverkusen in the summer of 2025. Manchester United's new manager Mauricio Pochettino will make his home bow as his 19th-placed side host Brentford on Saturday seeking only their second victory of the season. Fifth-placed Bournemouth will look to continue their stunning recent run as they eye a sixth successive league win when they face Fulham on Sunday.

Source: Reuters

item.title: キーウに弾道ミサイル攻撃、7人負傷＝市長
item.description: [２５日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[２５日 ロイター] - ウクライナの首都キーウが夜間にロシアの弾道ミサイル攻撃を受け、７人が負傷し、ショッピングセンターと他の２棟の建物が被弾した。キーウのクリチコ市長が明らかにした。一方、ロシア国防省はキーウ市内のドローン（無人機）関連施設を攻撃したとしている。

キーウ全域で一連の激しい爆発音が響き渡り、２６日朝になっても大規模な火災が続き、空に黒煙が立ち上っていた。

クリチコ氏によると、ミサイルは市内を二分するドニプロ川の東岸にあるショッピングセンターと他の２棟の建物を直撃。そのうち１棟が甚大な被害を受けたという。負傷者のうち２人が重体だという。

ロイターはこれらの発表を直ちに確認できなかった。

ウクライナ空軍によると、ロシアは夜間に弾道ミサイルに加え、１１３機の「シャヘド」型攻撃ドローンを発射した。暫定データによると、防空部隊が８７機のドローンを撃墜・無力化した。

item.title: ‘Carl Icahn Did Not Play Nice:’ Michael Dell Takes a Swipe at Billionaire as Activist Investor’s Fortune Reportedly Shrinks by $21 Billion
item.description: Michael Dell took a pointed swipe at billionaire activist investor Carl Icahn, reviving memories of their bitter corporate battle more than a decade ago as Icahn’s fortune reportedly dwindles amid ...
item.content:encoded:
News / Benzinga / ‘Carl Icahn Did Not Play Nice:’ Michael Dell Takes a Swipe at Billionaire as Activist Investor’s Fortune Reportedly Shrinks by $21 Bill…

‘Carl Icahn Did Not Play Nice:’ Michael Dell Takes a Swipe at Billionaire as Activist Investor’s Fortune Reportedly Shrinks by $21 Billion 2 min read

DELL IEP CVI Michael Dell took a pointed swipe at billionaire activist investor Carl Icahn , reviving memories of their bitter corporate battle more than a decade ago as Icahn’s fortune reportedly dwindles amid mounting financial pressures. The Dell Technologies Inc. DELL founder appeared to reference their 2013 showdown. The remark came after Bloomberg reported that Icahn’s wealth had fallen to roughly $1.3 billion, down about $21 billion over the past five years. Dell Takes a Swipe at Icahn “Carl Icahn did not play nice and he did not win,” Dell wrote in a post on X .

Michael Dell 🇺🇸 @MichaelDell

Carl Icahn did not play nice and he did not win #PlayNiceButWin

Nov 25, 2026

The post appeared to reference Dell’s 2021 memoir, "Play Nice But Win: A CEO’s Journey From Founder to Leader," which recounts his efforts to take his namesake company private and rebuild its business away from the pressures of quarterly earnings expectations. The 2013 confrontation pitted Dell’s plan to take the company private against Icahn’s alternative proposal. The activist investor opposed the buyout and pushed for a transaction involving a substantial share repurchase and warrants that would give shareholders exposure to future gains. Dell ultimately secured shareholder approval for the $24.9 billion buyout in Sept. 2013, taking the company private with financial backing from Silver Lake and other investors. The transaction was completed a month later. Carl Icahn did not immediately respond to Benzinga’s request for comment. Icahn’s Fortune Under Pressure Icahn’s wealth reportedly peaked at $26.1 billion in December 2013, when he ranked among the world’s 25 richest people. The pressure has intensified around Icahn Enterprises LP IEP , his publicly traded investment partnership. The company warned in its third-quarter (Q3) results that there was no assurance it could refinance $1.4 billion in bonds due in May on acceptable terms. Shares of CVR Energy Inc. CVI , a major IEP holding, have also dropped roughly 40% since the refiner agreed to acquire two additional refineries earlier this month. The History Behind Dell and Icahn’s Feud The two billionaires’ rivalry dates back to 2013, when Dell sought to take his company private in a deal valued at approximately $24.9 billion. Icahn emerged as a prominent opponent, arguing that shareholders would be better served by an alternative plan involving a large stock buyback and warrants. Icahn also challenged the buyout through public statements and legal action, while Dell argued that taking the company private would give it the flexibility to pursue a longer-term transformation. Dell’s buyout eventually went through, and the company began its transformation as a private enterprise. In 2016, Dell acquired EMC in a $67 billion transaction, expanding beyond its traditional PC business into enterprise storage and infrastructure. The company subsequently returned to public markets in December 2018, with its shares beginning regular trading on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker DELL. item.description:
Valentina Za
［ミラノ ２６日 ロイター］ - イタリアの銀行大手ウニクレディトは２６日、ドイツのコメルツ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
伊ウニクレディト、独コメルツ銀の監査役会刷新へ　当局承認完了 18:59 配信

写真は独コメルツ銀のロゴ。3月16日、ドイツのケルンにある支店で撮影。REUTERS/Thilo Schmuelgen（ロイター） Valentina Za

［ミラノ　２６日　ロイター］ - イタリアの銀行大手ウニクレディトは２６日、ドイツのコメルツ銀行の経営権取得に必要な当局の承認手続きを完了したことを受け、コメルツ銀の監査役会に自社の代表を送り込む手続きに入った。コメルツ銀は、ウニクレディトが監査役会の株主代表１０人のうち９人の交代を求め、アンドレア・オルチェル最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）を監査役会議長に指名する意向だとした。

ウニクレディトによると、ポーランド金融監督庁（ＫＮＦ）の承認が規制上の最終段階だった。手続きは１２月７日までに完了する見通しだとしている。

ウニクレディトはコメルツ銀に対する戦略を実行するため、同行に新たな経営トップを送り込むとみられる。合併に先立ち両行の「すり合わせ」を行うため、少なくとも２０２８年まではドイツ部門のＨＶＢとは別組織としておく計画だ。

コメルツ銀行によると、現在の監査役会会長で、ドイツ連邦銀行（中央銀行）元総裁のイェンス・ワイトマン氏の後任にはオルチェル氏が就く。

ウニクレディトの候補者リストには、同社の財務、デジタル、リスク管理の各部門トップと、新しい人事責任者が入っている。株主側から選ばれた監査役のうち留任させる予定なのは、英スタンダード・チャータードで最高情報責任者（ＣＩＯ）を務めたミヒャエル・ゴリツ氏だけだ。

コメルツ銀行によると、ウニクレディトは７人で構成する取締役会のメンバーの一部を退任させるよう監査役会に求めている。ただ、人数はまだ示していない。

ワイトマン氏は声明で「監査役会は、取締役会の新たな人事を進めるよう求めるウニクレディトの要請を検討する」と述べた。「現段階では、銀行の安定を確保し、顧客に注力することが重要だ」とした。

item.content:encoded:
ユーロ圏の企業向け融資、10月の伸びは3年余りぶりの高水準に 18:42 配信

写真はユーロ紙幣のイメージ。10月29日撮影。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic（ロイター） [フランクフルト ２６日 ロイター] - 欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）が２６日に発表したデータによると、１０月の非金融企業向け融資は前年同月比４．５％増加し、２０２３年４月以来の高い伸びを記録した。家計向け融資の伸びは横ばいの３．１％だった。

ユーロ圏経済が高騰するエネルギー価格に対しても依然として底堅さを維持していることを示した。

将来の経済活動の先行指標とされることが多い、ユーロ圏のマネーサプライ「Ｍ３」は前年比３．６％増で横ばいとなり、アナリスト予想の３．５％増を上回った。

item.title: ＣＰＴＰＰとＥＵ、供給網の早期警戒メカニズム設置で合意
item.description:
Khanh Vu
[ハノイ ２６日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Khanh Vu

[ハノイ ２６日 ロイター] - 環太平洋連携協定（ＣＰＴＰＰ）、東南アジア諸国連合（ＡＳＥＡＮ）、欧州連合（ＥＵ）の通商担当閣僚らは２６日、ベトナムで経済対話のため会合を開いた。

米国が過剰生産能力に関する調査を受けて打ち出した一連の新関税の対象となった１４カ国・地域のうち、日本、ＥＵ、シンガポール、タイ、マレーシア、ベトナムなどが会合に参加した。

ＥＵのシェフチョビッチ欧州委員（通商担当）は、物流や貿易円滑化、サプライチェーンについて議論したと説明した。通商の混乱を和らげるため、ＥＵとＣＰＴＰＰがサプライチェーンの強靭性に関する早期警戒メカニズムの設置で合意したと明らかにした。

記者団に「過去数年でサプライチェーンがいかにして武器化され得るかを目の当たりにしてきたため、サプライチェーンが良好に機能するよう大いに注意を払う必要がある」と語った。

＜環太平洋協定「これまで以上に重要」＞

オーストラリアのファレル貿易相は会合に先立つ声明で、ＣＰＴＰＰの対話では公正で開かれた貿易の維持にも焦点を当てると述べた。「現在の世界の貿易環境において、ＣＰＴＰＰの高い基準、安定性、予見可能性はこれまで以上に重要になっている」とした。

シェフチョビッチ氏は、ＥＵが過剰生産能力の源だとする米国の前提を強く否定すると述べ、ＥＵが米国と妥結した１５％の関税率を米国が尊重することが重要だと訴えた。

「むしろ、われわれは世界的な過剰生産能力の悪影響に最もさらされている経済圏の一つだと言える」とし「ＥＵと米国が協力すれば、世界的な過剰生産能力に対処する共同行動として、より多くのことができるはずだ」と語った。
