item.content:encoded:
マクロスコープ：株価下落、政府内に「備え」求める声　高市政権の財政余力が鍵に 11:51 配信

写真は都内の株価ボード。2022年6月撮影。REUTERS/Issei Kato（ロイター） Yoshifumi Takemoto　Tamiyuki Kihara

[東京 ２６日 ロイター] - 株価の下落傾向が続いている。日経平均株価は今月２０日、終値で約７カ月ぶりとなる５万６０００円台をつけた。ＡＩ（人工知能）・半導体バブルの崩壊への警戒感が強まる中、複数の政府関係者は「様子見」を決め込むが、今後の市場動向次第では政権の財政政策に影響を与えかねない。リスクへの備えが求められるものの、関係者からは「すでに財政余力はなくなりつつある」と懸念する声が出ている。

＜「リーマンか、ドットコムか」＞

「今回のバブルはリーマンとドットコムのどちらに似ているのか」。経済政策の立案に関わる政府幹部の一人は最近、複数の市場関係者にこう尋ねて回った。米大手投資銀行の経営破綻を契機に世界的な金融危機を招いた２００８年のリーマンショック。１９９０年代後半にＩＴ関連企業の株価が急騰し、その後下落に転じたドットコムバブル。幹部はそれらの「教訓」から、今後のリスクへの備えを固めようと考えたわけだ。

メガバンク関係者は幹部に、「それは絶対、ドットコムだ。金融システムは大丈夫だから」と答えたという。成長見通しが不透明でビジネスモデルも未成熟なＩＴ関連企業に資金が集中した当時と、ＡＩ・半導体関連企業の動向に一喜一憂する足元の市場には共通点があるとの見方だ。幹部は、実体経済に大きな影響はないとの趣旨だと受け止めた。

現状を過度に不安視しないこうした意見は、政府・与党内にもある。経済官庁幹部は「最近ずっと株価はバブル状態だった。いずれ調整が入ると思っていた」としつつ、「だからといって経済が逆回転するような展開に直ちになるかというと何とも言えない」と述べ、状況を注視する段階だとの認識を示した。自民党の政務三役経験者は、「ＡＩ関連企業はこれからも成長する。このところの株価は下がり過ぎだ。絶好の買い場じゃないか」とも言い切った。

＜細る「財政余力」への懸念＞

ただ、高市早苗首相が進める財政政策への影響を危惧する声もある。財政に精通するある政府関係者が口にしたキーワードは、「財政余力」だ。高市氏は経済安全保障などの重点分野への大規模投資や飲食料品の消費減税などを推進する一方、２０２７年度予算の特例公債（赤字国債）の新規発行を４０兆円程度に抑える方針を示している。その他の財源には増加を見込む税収のほか、外国為替特別会計（外為特会）の剰余金のさらなる活用、日銀保有のＥＴＦ（上場投資信託）の追加売却益などを当て込む構えだ。

財政政策に携わる別の関係者は「日本はここ数十年、投資不足の経済だと実感している」と高市氏の政策方針に賛同する一方、「国が取捨選択をしっかり行わないまま、どこまで企業投資を支援するのかを世界の市場が注視している」と説明。経済の悪化でさらなる財政出動に頼ることになれば、市場の信認が揺らぐ事態は避けられないとの認識を示した。

財政に精通する前出の政府関係者は２５日、株価下落を伝えるテレビ画面を眺め、「原油価格もまだまだどうなるか分からない。株価がさらに下落する可能性も十分あるだろう」と話した。そして、こう付け加えた。「リスクに備えて財政余力を確保しておきたいところだが、すでに使えるものは全て使っている状態だ。紛争の激化や災害など、あと一つ何か大きな出来事が起きれば行き詰まりかねない」

＜政府は「高い緊張感」をもって注視＞

株価の下落による高市政権への影響を専門家はどう見ているのか。野村総合研究所エグゼクティブ・エコノミストの木内登英氏は２６日、ＡＩ関連株は調整の最中にあるとし、「大きなクラッシュのような形になるかは分からない」としながらも、調整局面は長引くのではないかとの見方を示した。背景には、米国のＡＩ産業そのものへの逆風や、過剰投資や過剰債務の問題があると指摘。「米の成長率の半分はＡＩ関連とされており、米経済の成長が下振れれば、日本からの米への自動車輸出などが減り、日本経済にも逆風となる。資金の出し手が慎重になることで、米新興企業の経営不安も想定される」と分析した。

高市政権への影響については、金利上昇懸念や米国からの批判に対応するため、政権が「財政拡張にやや慎重になっているとみられる」が、ＡＩ関連株の調整が実体経済に影響し始めれば、「再び積極財政方向に動く可能性があり、金利上昇、円安の動きにつながる可能性がある」と説明。「日本経済への影響が大きければ、追加的な経済対策が必要となる。補正予算に頼らないとする政権の基本方針を維持するのは難しくなる」と話した。

株安への事前の備えは「難しい」とする一方、「経済の安定という観点から、政府は健全な財政政策運営を行い、日銀は必要な金利引き上げを進める」ことが望ましいと強調した。

木原稔官房長官は２６日の記者会見でロイターの質問に、日々の株価動向についての具体的コメントは控えた。その上で「政府としては引き続き動向を高い緊張感をもって注視していく」とした。また、株価下落が実体経済に与える影響は「さまざまであり、一概に答えることは困難だ」と説明。経済や物価、金融動向、政策効果を巡る不確実性に備え、「経済財政運営の点検」を実施しつつ、良質な雇用と所得を増やし、消費マインドの改善と事業収益の向上を実現することで「ＧＤＰ（国内総生産）拡大のもとで（経済の）好循環を実現していきたい」と述べた。

（竹本能文、鬼原民幸　編集：橋本浩）

item.title: Networking, communications to dominate India's semiconductor market with 33.3% share by 2030: CareEdge
item.description: Networking and communications is projected to emerge as the largest segment of India's semiconductor market by 2030, according to a report by CareEdge Advisory.
item.content:encoded:
Networking, communications to dominate India's semiconductor market with 33.3% share by 2030: CareEdge Networking and communications is projected to emerge as the largest segment of India's semiconductor market by 2030, according to a report by CareEdge Advisory. ANI | Updated: 26-11-2026 16:03 IST | Created: 26-11-2026 16:03 IST

Representative Image (Photo/Reuters). Image Credit: ANI

SHARE

Key Takeaways AI Summary

Analyzing article...

Networking and communications is projected to emerge as the largest segment of India's semiconductor market by 2030, according to a report by CareEdge Advisory. The report noted that India's semiconductor demand is gradually shifting from traditional consumer electronics towards connectivity and computing applications. "The demand mix is increasingly shifting towards connectivity and computing applications," the report said. The share of networking and communications in semiconductor revenues is projected to increase from 26.1 per cent in 2020 to 33.3 per cent by 2030, with the segment registering a compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of 17.8 per cent. This growth will be supported by rising semiconductor demand from 5G deployment, network modernisation, fibre infrastructure expansion and increasing data traffic, as per the report. “Networking & Communications and Computing & Data Storage together are estimated to account for over 50.0% of semiconductor revenue by CY30,” it said. As per the report, the share of the computing and data storage segment is expected to increase from 12.8 per cent to 15.1 per cent during the same period, with the segment growing at a CAGR of 11.9 per cent. In contrast, the share of consumer electronics is projected to decline from 29.1 per cent to 22.2 per cent, reflecting the growing contribution of digital infrastructure, cloud computing and artificial intelligence (AI)-led demand. Overall, India's semiconductor market is projected to more than double from USD 45-50 billion in 2026 to USD 100-110 billion by 2030. However, limited domestic manufacturing capacity continues to drive India's dependence on semiconductor imports. "India’s semiconductor imports more than tripled from USD 11.9 billion in FY21 to USD 36.5 billion in FY26," the report said, highlighting that "imports account for 90–95% of domestic demand for semiconductor devices and components." To strengthen domestic manufacturing capabilities, 12 semiconductor projects involving cumulative investments exceeding Rs 1.64 lakh crore have been approved under the India Semiconductor Mission across six states. Of these, five projects had commenced commercial production by October 2026. The next phase of the mission is expected to strengthen capabilities in research and development, materials, equipment and talent development. The report further noted that while India has established expertise in chip design and related services, wafer fabrication remains at an early stage, with limited domestic capabilities in semiconductor materials and manufacturing equipment. "Timely project execution, manufacturing yields, technology partnerships, specialised talent and supplier development will be essential to improving domestic value addition and strengthening supply-chain resilience," the report said. (ANI)

Data centre rush drives biggest rise in Australian business investment since mining boom

FILE PHOTO: People work at a site of a new Amazon data centre that is under construction in western Sydney, Australia, September 5, 2025. REUTERS/Hollie Adam/File Photo

26 Nov 2026 10:29AM

FAST

SYDNEY, Nov 26 : Australian business investment surged anew in the September quarter as firms poured money into data centres, recording its biggest rise since 2011 at the height of the mining boom, while companies further upgraded spending plans for coming months. The strong numbers on Thursday suggested some resilience in the Australian economy even as five interest rate hikes this year triggered the biggest housing downturn in 40 years, hit consumer spending and weakened the labour market. The local dollar rose 0.2 per cent to $0.6640 and three-year government bond futures reversed earlier gains to be down three ticks to 95.51. The Australian Bureau of Statistics reported private capital spending jumped 12.2 per cent in the third quarter to an inflation-adjusted A$59.5 billion ($39.37 billion), far above market forecasts of a 4.4 per cent rise.  That was led by an 87 per cent jump in spending on information media and telecommunications equipment amid record investment in server racks and processing gear for data centres. Much of this was on imported equipment and thus an offsetting drag on economic growth.

Abhijit Surya, senior APAC economist at Capital Economics, said spending on information and communications technology could nearly double in the 2027 financial year, in contrast with the rest of the economy, where capital spending was struggling to tread water. "With the RBA clearly concerned about capacity pressures, the data suggest it won’t be in a rush to cut rates anytime soon," Surya said.  Markets are still wagering that the next move in interest rates will be down, but do not fully price a first cut from the Reserve Bank of Australia until August. A June cut is now seen as an 83 per cent chance. Overall spending on plant and machinery shot up 23.1 per cent, while spending on buildings and structures rose 1.7 per cent. An ABS survey of firms showed they planned to spend A$223.7 billion in the year to June 2027, 11.8 per cent higher than the previous estimate. ($1 = 1.5113 Australian dollars)

item.title: ノルスク・ハイドロ、カタール合弁のアルミ生産を来年第1四半期に全面回復へ
item.description:
Tom Daly
[ロンドン ２５日 ロイター] - ノルウェーのノルスク・ハイドロのエイビン・カルレビック最高経営...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ノルスク・ハイドロ、カタール合弁のアルミ生産を来年第1四半期に全面回復へ 11:01 配信

ノルスク・ハイドロのロゴ。2022年5月3日撮影。 REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration/File Photo（ロイター） Tom Daly

[ロンドン ２５日 ロイター] - ノルウェーのノルスク・ハイドロのエイビン・カルレビック最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は２５日、カタールのアルミニウム合弁会社カタラムについて、２０２７年第１・四半期の全面的な生産回復に向けて順調に進んでいると述べた。ハイドロはカタラム製アルミの販売業務も暫定的に再開した。

米国とイスラエルによる対イラン戦争で供給の混乱が数カ月続く中、アルミ取引業者は、世界の生産能力の約９％を占める中東の製錬所の増産動向を注視している。

ハイドロとカタール・アルミニウム・マニュファクチャリングが共同出資するカタラムは、紛争開始後のガス不足を受け、３月３日に段階的な操業停止に着手。しかし、その１週間ほど後には減産措置を打ち切り、生産能力の６０％の水準で操業を続けた。

カルレビック氏はロンドンで開いた投資家向け説明会で、現在は生産能力の約７０％まで生産を引き上げたと説明した。「湾岸地域の現状が維持されれば、引き続き生産を拡大し、できれば２７年第１・四半期にフル稼働に戻したい」と述べた。

カタラムの一次アルミ生産能力は年間６４万８０００トン。

カタラムは６月、ハイドロへのアルミ販売代理業務の委託を突然打ち切った。これを受け、ハイドロは顧客向け出荷について不可抗力を宣言した。

item.title: When Wall Street’s fear gauges flash red, what happens next?: Stan Wong
item.description: While heightened market volatility can create considerable anxiety, history suggests that periods of extreme pessimism have frequently been followed by strong equity market returns.
item.content:encoded:
“Be fearful when others are greedy and be greedy when others are fearful.” Warren Buffett’s famous advice captures a fundamental principle of investing: some of the most attractive opportunities emerge when investor confidence is at its lowest. While heightened market volatility can create considerable anxiety, history suggests that periods of extreme pessimism have frequently been followed by strong equity market returns.

Wall Street’s fear gauges are flashing red Two measures of this anxiety are the Cboe Volatility Index (VIX) and Nasdaq-100 Volatility Index (VXN) , commonly known as Wall Street’s “fear gauges.” Derived from options prices, they measure expected volatility over the next 30 days for the S&P 500 and Nasdaq-100, respectively. These indicators typically rise when markets decline and investors seek protection against further losses. Higher readings signal expectations for larger market fluctuations, not their direction. Historically, VIX readings below 20 generally reflect calmer conditions, while readings above 30 indicate heightened anxiety. At extreme levels, these fear gauges can also serve as contrarian indicators, suggesting that investor pessimism may have become excessive. Last Friday, Nov. 20, the VIX closed at 35.9 and the VXN at 45.3. Comparable spikes occurred following sweeping U.S. tariff announcements in April 2025, during the inflation-driven bear market of 2022 and amid the COVID-19 market collapse in March 2020. Each period demonstrated how quickly investor confidence can deteriorate. But what does history tell us about what happens after fear reaches such extreme levels? What 25 years of market history reveal My analysis of Bloomberg data over the past 25 years examined subsequent 12-month equity returns following elevated volatility readings, using non-overlapping observation windows to avoid counting repeated signals during the same periods of turbulence. For the S&P 500, nine completed qualifying signals occurred when the VIX rose above 35. The index generated a median return of 15.5 per cent over the subsequent 12 months, with positive returns in seven of nine observations, or 77.8 per cent. Remarkably, the analysis identified just four completed, non-overlapping signals over the past 25 years when the VXN climbed above 45, highlighting how rare such extreme Nasdaq-100 volatility has been. Following these signals, the Nasdaq-100 generated a median 12-month return of 25.0 per cent, with positive returns in three of four observations. These median returns represent the midpoint of historical outcomes, reducing the influence of unusually large gains or losses. The findings reinforce the potential value of these volatility measures as contrarian indicators: periods of extreme fear have often preceded favourable 12-month equity returns. However, the small number of observations means they should not be viewed as consistently reliable predictors of future performance. Because the Nasdaq-100 typically experiences greater price fluctuations than the S&P 500, VXN readings tend to be higher than those of the VIX. The threshold of 45 therefore provides useful historical perspective on the elevated Nasdaq-100 volatility on Nov.20. When fear is not a buying signal Not every volatility spike precedes a recovery. The dot-com collapse beginning in 2000, market turmoil following the events of Sept. 11, 2001, the global financial crisis of 2008 and the inflation-driven bear market of 2022 illustrate how deeper economic and financial challenges can prolong equity weakness. When volatility coincides with weakening earnings, deteriorating economic conditions or financial instability, markets can remain under pressure. Extreme fear alone does not establish that a market bottom has arrived. Looking beyond market fear Market corrections are not created equal. A decline driven by deteriorating earnings, recessionary conditions or financial instability differs fundamentally from a selloff driven primarily by changing investor sentiment or valuation compression. When share prices fall faster than underlying earnings expectations, valuations become more attractive, potentially improving the outlook for subsequent returns if corporate fundamentals remain resilient. This is particularly relevant for technology and artificial intelligence-related companies, where strong long-term growth prospects can coexist with substantial short-term volatility. Widespread pessimism can create opportunities to acquire fundamentally strong businesses at more attractive valuations. The challenge is distinguishing temporary sentiment shifts from genuine deterioration in business fundamentals. Investor behaviour may be the greatest risk Elevated volatility does not guarantee that markets have bottomed. Even when historical evidence suggests favourable forward returns, further short-term declines remain possible. Maintaining perspective during these periods is essential. Investment decisions should reflect an investor’s long-term objectives, financial goals, risk tolerance, and time horizon, supported by a comprehensive total wealth plan. A disciplined approach can help investors avoid emotional decisions that turn temporary market declines into permanent investment losses. In the end, the greatest investment risk during periods of heightened volatility may not be volatility itself, but investor behaviour. item.description:
Takahiko Wada
[甲府市 ２６日 ロイター] - 日銀の田村直樹審議委員は２６日、金融環境が現状、依然とし...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
政策金利は早期に中立水準へ、物価上振れの兆しに「俊敏な反応を」＝田村委員 10:59 配信

2026年9月18日、都内の日銀本店。REUTERS/Kim Kyung-Hoon（ロイター） Takahiko Wada

[甲府市　２６日　ロイター] - 日銀の田村直樹審議委員は２６日、金融環境が現状、依然として緩和的な状態にあることを踏まえれば、政策金利を「中立水準に早く持っていく必要がある」との考えを示した。基調的な物価上昇率の２％目標への定着度合いが低い状況下では、物価上振れの兆しに対し「利上げペースの加速など、俊敏に反応していくことが求められる」とした。

山梨県金融経済懇談会であいさつした。田村委員は政策委員の中でもタカ派に位置付けられる。６月には中立金利を「２％前後」と明言したが、それ以降の政策変更やそれに伴う様々な指標の状況、企業の声を踏まえても「その考えは変わっていない」と述べた。

利上げペースについては、企業の声や各種アンケート調査から金融環境の評価が相応にできる期間として数カ月程度が望ましいとの考えを改めて示した。利上げの影響の見極めは丁寧に行う必要があるが、それは「ゆっくり」ということを意味せず、日銀には現状、「『悠々として急ぐ』ということが求められている」と話した。

田村委員は、基調的な物価上昇率が２％目標を超えて上振れていくリスクに強い警戒感を示した。足元の物価動向には「さらなる上振れリスクがうかがわれる」としたほか、需給ギャップのプラス圏推移や企業の価格設定行動の積極化など「物価が上振れやすい環境」が出来上がっていると述べた。「外生的なショックが生じた場合、わが国の基調的な物価上昇率は大きく変動する懸念がある」と語り、日銀として、外生的なショックには「俊敏かつ強く反応していくことが求められる」と述べた。

金融環境の判断に当たっては、企業の声を指標以上に重視していると述べた。その上で「これまでの利上げや当面のさらなる利上げがビジネス活動に与える影響は限定的との声が大半だ」と説明した。

経済については「今後も、底堅さを維持していく」との見方を示した。特にグローバルな人工知能（ＡＩ）関連需要について「私としても驚くほど、わが国経済を幅広く上押ししている」と話した。

田村委員は、基調物価が２％目標を超えて上振れていくリスクが顕在化し、その後の経済に悪影響を及ぼずことがないようにすることが日銀の使命だと語った。

item.description:
Mike Scarcella
[ワシントン ２５日 ロイター] - 米半導体大手エヌビディアは、画像処理半導体（ＧＰＵ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
エヌビディア、18年の株主集団訴訟で和解　2.9億ドル支払いへ 10:56 配信

2026年11月23日、米カリフォルニア州サンタクララにあるエヌビディア本社。 REUTERS/Carlos Barria/File Photo（ロイター） Mike Scarcella

[ワシントン ２５日 ロイター] - 米半導体大手エヌビディアは、画像処理半導体（ＧＰＵ）の売り上げが変動の激しい暗号資産（仮想通貨）採掘業界によってどの程度押し上げられていたかについて株主に誤解を与えたとして投資家が起こした訴訟で、２億９０００万ドルを支払うことで和解に合意した。２４日の裁判所提出文書で明らかになった。

詳細は以下の通り。

• スウェーデンのストックホルムに拠点を置く投資運用会社 E. Ohman J:or Fonder ABが起こした訴訟を主導する原告側弁護士は２４日、米カリフォルニア州の連邦地裁に集団訴訟の和解案を仮承認するよう求めた。

• 和解の対象は２０１８年に提起された訴訟で、同社とジェンスン・フアン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）に対する現在の調査とは無関係。和解案には判事の承認が必要となる。

• 原告側は、エヌビディアが急増するゲーム関連売上高について、暗号資産採掘業者ではなく、ゲーム需要によるものだと投資家に誤った説明をしたと主張していた。

• エヌビディアは和解に当たり、不正行為を否定した。同社は声明で「１０年近く前のパソコンゲーム市場の状況に関する訴訟」を解決したとし、「この過去の問題の解決を支援し、２億９０００万ドルの和解金の大半を負担する保険会社の貢献に感謝する」と述べた。

item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
東電の柏崎刈羽原発、テロ対策施設の工事工程見直し決定 10:51 配信

東京電力（TEPCO）のロゴ。2016年3月2日、都内で撮影。REUTERS/Toru Hanai（ロイター） [東京 ２６日 ロイター] - 東京電力ホールディングスは２６日、柏崎刈羽原子力発電所（新潟県）の６号機と７号機のテロ対策施設「特定重大事故等対処施設」について、工事工程を見直すと発表した。

主要構築物を建設している施行会社から工程を変更したい旨の報告があったほか、主要構築物の一部でコンクリートの仕上がりに不均一の部分があると確認したことなどから、見直しが必要と判断した。

同社は昨年２月、工事完了時期を延期し、７号機の特重は２０２９年８月めど、６号機は３１年９月めどに変更していた。

特重は発電所への意図的な航空機衝突による大規模な損壊で広範囲に設備が使えなくなった場合に原子炉格納容器の破損防止に必要な機能を備えた施設で、原発の新たな規制基準で設置が義務付けられている。

item.description: [広州 ２５日 ロイター] - 中国の電気自動車（ＥＶ）メーカー、蔚来汽車（ＮＩＯ）の李斌（ウィリアム・リー）最高経...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
中国ＥＶのＮＩＯ、ＡＩ活用で粗利益率10％ポイント改善目指す 10:44 配信

中国の電気自動車（ＥＶ）メーカー、蔚来汽車（ＮＩＯ）のロゴ。2026年4月24日、北京で撮影。 REUTERS/Maxim Shemetov（ロイター） [広州 ２５日 ロイター] - 中国の電気自動車（ＥＶ）メーカー、蔚来汽車（ＮＩＯ）の李斌（ウィリアム・リー）最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は２５日、業務効率の向上を図るため各事業部門に人工知能（ＡＩ）を導入することで、長期的には粗利益率を１０％ポイント上げることができると述べた。

• ２７日に開幕する広州モーターショーに先立ち、同市で開催された「テクノロジー・デー」で、研究開発、製造、物流、自動車販売などの分野に７５００体のＡＩエージェントを導入したと発表した。

• リー氏は記者団に、自動車メーカーの事業運営にＡＩを組み込むことは「競争力を維持し、次の変革の波をけん引するために極めて重要になる」と語った。

• また第３世代の「ワールドモデル」を発表。ＮＩＯによると、このモデルの先進運転支援システム（ＡＤＡＳ）では、ドライバーによる介入が４０％削減され、技術のトレーニングに必要な演算能力も低減される。

• 同社は第２・四半期に５億元（７４９５万ドル）の純損失を計上したが、損失幅は前年同期比８９．４％減少した。

item.description: [２５日 ロイター] - 米アマゾン・ドット・コムは２５日、オンライン自動車販売事業アマゾン・オートを英国で２０２７年...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
アマゾン、来年に英国でオンライン自動車販売開始　米国外で初 10:40 配信

アマゾンのロゴ。2020年9月3日、英ダーリントンで撮影。 REUTERS/Lee Smith/File Photo（ロイター） [２５日 ロイター] - 米アマゾン・ドット・コムは２５日、オンライン自動車販売事業アマゾン・オートを英国で２０２７年初頭に立ち上げると発表した。同事業を米国以外へ初めて拡大する。

アマゾンにとって韓国の現代自動車 が新車および中古の電気自動車（ＥＶ）、ハイブリッド車、ガソリン車を提供する最初のパートナー企業の１社となる。現代は小型ＥＶ「アイオニック３」、ＳＵＶ（スポーツタイプ多目的車）「アイオニック５」、ＳＵＶ「コナ」、小型ハッチバック「ｉ２０」などを扱っている。

英ディーラーグループ、ヴァーチュ・モーターズ の中古車も事業開始時に掲載される予定だ。アマゾンによると、今後数カ月のうちにさらに多くのブランドやディーラーが発表されるという。

購入希望者はアマゾンの英国向け公式サイトで車を閲覧して表示価格を確認し、車を予約するとともに、所有車の目安となる査定額を入手し、融資の選択肢を検討することが可能。一方、購入手続きはディーラーの店舗で完了する。価格はディーラーが独自に設定する。

アマゾン・オート・インターナショナルの責任者、マット・ナフォート氏は「車の購入は人々にとって最大の買い物の一つで、アマゾンで他の商品を買うのと同じくらい簡単で透明性のある体験であるべきだ」と述べた。

アマゾン・オートは２４年１２月に米国でサービスを開始し、それ以来１５０余りの都市で事業展開している。

item.title: 豪企業設備投資、資源ブーム以来の大幅増 データセンター向け主導
item.description: [シドニー ２６日 ロイター] - オーストラリア統計局が２６日発表した第３・四半期の企業設備投資（インフレ調整済み）...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
豪企業設備投資、資源ブーム以来の大幅増　データセンター向け主導 10:31 配信

2025年9月5日、豪シドニー西部で建設中のデータセンター。 REUTERS/Hollie Adam/File Photo（ロイター） [シドニー ２６日 ロイター] - オーストラリア統計局が２６日発表した第３・四半期の企業設備投資（インフレ調整済み）は１２．２％増の５９５億豪ドル（３９３億７０００万米ドル）となった。伸び率は市場予想（４．４％）を大きく上回り、資源ブームがピークに達した２０１１年以来の大きさとなった。

企業がデータセンターに多額の資金を投じたことが背景で、今後数カ月の設備投資計画もさらに引き上げられた。

オーストラリア準備銀行（中央銀行）による今年５回の利上げが４０年ぶりの大幅な住宅市場の落ち込みを招き、個人消費や労働市場に悪影響を及ぼす中でも、好調な設備投資統計は豪経済の一定の底堅さを示した。豪ドルは０．２％上昇し、０．６６４０米ドルとなった。３年物豪国債先物は下落に転じ、３ティック安の９５．５１となった。

データセンター向けのサーバーラックや処理装置への投資が過去最高となる中、情報メディア・通信機器への投資が８７％増加し、全体をけん引した。

キャピタル・エコノミクスのアジア太平洋担当シニアエコノミスト、アビジット・スーリヤ氏は、情報通信技術への投資が２７年度にほぼ倍増する可能性があると指摘。他の分野では設備投資の横ばい維持さえ難しい状況と対照的だとした。

同氏は「豪中銀が供給能力への圧力を明らかに懸念している中、今回の統計は中銀が当面、利下げを急がないことを示唆している」と述べた。

市場は依然として次の金利変更が利下げになると見込んでいるものの、初回利下げを完全に織り込んでいるのは２７年８月。６月の利下げ確率は現在８３％となっている。

設備・機械への投資全体は２３．１％急増し、建物・構築物への投資は１．７％増加した。統計局の企業調査によると、２７年６月までの１年間の設備投資計画は２２３７億豪ドルと、前回の計画から１１．８％引き上げられた。

みずほ証券、印投資銀アベンダス株60％超取得　550億円超 10:25 配信

[東京 ２６日 ロイター] - みずほフィナンシャルグループ は２６日、傘下のみずほ証券がインドの投資銀行アベンダス・キャピタルの株式６０％超を取得し、連結子会社化したと発表した。広報によると、取得額は約５５０億円超。

item.title: 韓国中銀、0.25％利上げ 27年成長率予想4.1％に引き上げ
item.description:
Cynthia Kim Jihoon Lee
[ソウル ２６日 ロイター] - 韓国銀行（中央銀行）は２６日、政策金利...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
韓国中銀、0.25％利上げ　27年成長率予想4.1％に引き上げ 10:17 配信

2026年10月28日、ソウルの韓国銀行（中央銀行）本店前。 REUTERS/Kim Soo-hyeon（ロイター） Cynthia Kim　Jihoon Lee

[ソウル ２６日 ロイター] - 韓国銀行（中央銀行）は２６日、政策金利を０．２５％ポイント引き上げ、３．２５％とした。半導体主導の輸出ブームを背景にインフレが高止まりする中、１０月に休止した利上げサイクルを再開した。

今回の利上げは、中東での戦争に伴うコモディティー価格や供給面の持続的な圧力に直面する他の新興国と足並みをそろえる動きとなる。

７人で構成する金融通貨委員会は、政策金利である７日物レポ金利を２０２４年１１月以来の高水準に引き上げることを賛成５、反対２で決めた。ロイターが調査したアナリスト３４人のうち３２人が利上げを予想していた。

中銀は２６年の経済成長率見通しも従来の３．３％から３．９％に引き上げた。２７年は４．１％と、従来の２．９％から上方修正した。実現すれば、４．７％成長を記録した２１年以来の高い伸びとなる。

教保証券のアナリスト、ペク・ユンミン氏は「全会一致の利上げではなく反対票を伴ったことで微妙なバランスが取れた。ドットチャート（政策金利見通し）でも３．２５％と３．７５％の間でバランスが見られた」と述べた。

＜根強い物価上昇圧力＞

四半期ごとに示される見通しでは、６カ月後の政策金利について、委員の予想が３．２５％、３．５０％、３．７５％にほぼ均等に分かれた。

中銀は今回の声明で、追加利上げの「時期」を見極めると表明した。これまでは「時期とペース」を見極めるとしていた。

ペク氏は文言変更について、現在の利上げサイクルがあと１─２回の利上げで終了することを示唆していると指摘。２７年第１・四半期に１回利上げがあるとの予想を維持した。

政策金利の動向に敏感な韓国の３年物国債先物は０３３５ＧＭＴ（日本時間午後０時３５分）時点で０．１８ポイント安の１０３．８３となった。

中銀は２７年のインフレ率予想も従来の２．３％から２．４％に引き上げ、インフレがより根強く続くとの見通しを示した。

申鉉松総裁は記者会見で「インフレ率が目標（２％）に戻るのは再来年になる見通しだ。ただ、先手を打って行動することで、全体的な引き締め度合いを抑えられる」と述べた。

根強いインフレの主因は依然として川上の継続的なコスト圧力だが、底堅い内需も大きく影響していると説明した。

利上げは７月と８月の連続利上げに続き、２６年に入って３回目。累計の利上げ幅は７５ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）となった。

アナリストは、中銀が２７年第１・四半期に最後の０．２５％ポイントの利上げを実施し、政策金利が今回の利上げ局面の到達点となる３．５０％に達した後、同年末まで据え置かれると予想している。

アジア第４位の経済規模を持つ韓国は、世界的な半導体需要の急増を受け、今年は予想を上回る成長を遂げている。住宅市場が過熱し、総合インフレ率が中銀目標の２％を大きく上回って推移する中、政策当局者はタカ派姿勢を維持している。

item.title: 米ディア、27年度利益見通しが予想下回る 農機回復鈍く
item.description:
Nandan Mandayam Nathan Gomes
[２５日 ロイター] - 米農機大手ディアが２５日発表した通...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米ディア、27年度利益見通しが予想下回る　農機回復鈍く 9:56 配信

米農機大手ディア製コンバインで小麦を収穫する様子。2022年7月、フランス・シュルビリエで撮影。REUTERS/Benoit Tessier（ロイター） Nandan Mandayam　Nathan Gomes

[２５日 ロイター] - 米農機大手ディアが２５日発表した通期利益見通しは、市場予想を下回った。農業市場全般の低迷が重しとなっている。

ただ、建設機械や芝刈り機など小型機器の需要に支えられて四半期売上高が予想を上回ったことから、株価は上昇した。

北米市場の長期にわたる低迷は、ディアやＣＮＨなど農機メーカーに打撃を与えている。農作物価格の低迷とインフレの加速により、農家が新たな機械の購入を控えている。

ディアは人工知能（ＡＩ）向けデータセンターへの投資に減速の兆しがないか注視していると述べた。データセンターの建設拡大は、同社の建設・林業機械部門の好調を支えてきた。

同部門の通期売上高は横ばいから最大１０％の増加を見込んだ。

ディアは鉄鋼など原材料に対する米関税によるコスト増にも直面している。 ２０２７年度の関税コストは１０億ドルと予想。前年度の１１億ドルをやや下回る見通しだ。２６年度には関税の還付３億８３００万ドルを計上した。

主力の精密農業部門の売上高は５─１５％増、小型農機部門は横ばいを見込む。

通期純利益見通しは４５億─５２億５０００万ドル。任意の一時金による年金給付オプションに関連する２億５０００万─４億ドルの一時的な非現金費用が含まれる。ＬＳＥＧがまとめたアナリストの平均予想は５９億１０００万ドルだった。

四半期純利益は１０億５０００万ドル（１株当たり３．８９ドル）と小幅に減少した。アナリストは１株４．０５ドルへの増加を予想していた。純売上高は１０５億１０００万ドルに減少したものの、市場予想の１０３億７０００万ドルを上回った。

item.title: Trump touts Iran naval blockade and "one-day win" in Venezuela while slamming reporter over coverage
item.description: In a post on his Truth Social platform, Trump sang praises of his administration's achievements, citing the closing of the border, crime stats, and tax and regulation cuts among others.
item.content:encoded:
Trump touts Iran naval blockade and "one-day win" in Venezuela while slamming reporter over coverage In a post on his Truth Social platform, Trump sang praises of his administration's achievements, citing the closing of the border, crime stats, and tax and regulation cuts among others.  ANI | Updated: 26-11-2026 14:04 IST | Created: 26-11-2026 14:04 IST

US President Donald Trump (Photo/Reuters). Image Credit: ANI

SHARE

Key Takeaways AI Summary

Analyzing article...

US President Donald Trump on Thursday (local time) slammed New York Times correspondent David E. Sanger for omitting what he described as key administrative achievements from his recent report, calling him a "mediocre reporter" who "only writes what he is told to write by his bosses". In a post on his Truth Social platform, Trump sang praises of his administration's achievements, citing the closing of the border, crime stats, and tax and regulation cuts among others. Mentioning two of his latest military operations: Iran and Venezuela, the US President highlighted "the most successful naval blockade" amid the ongoing conflict with Iran while reiterating his claims of annihilating the Iranian navy and air force "and more!" and his "ONE DAY WIN" against Venezuela. "David E. Sanger, the mediocre reporter for the Failing New York Times, didn’t mention in his recent story on me the successful closing of the Border, best crime stats in years (lowest murder rate since 1900 - 126 years!), biggest Tax and Regulation Cuts, EVER, the most successful naval blockade in history, the destruction of Iran’s Navy and Air Force (and more!), the ONE DAY WIN against Venezuela," he wrote. Further hailing the recent controlled detonation of nearly five tonnes of unstable lead azide at the Iowa Army Ammunition Plant, Trump wrote, " and today’s big success in straightening out the Obama-caused mess in Iowa." Trump also noted market performance "until the election" and his claim of settling 8 wars to slam the journalist for failing to cover the administration's contribution in boosting the pride of the country. "David Sanger is a lowlife that only writes what he is told to write by his bosses. Also, until the Election, best Market, EVER, 82 days, settled 8 Wars, and the USA is respected again like never before!" Trump asserted. Trump's post reflects his continued criticism of mainstream media outlets and their reporting on foreign policy and national security matters, particularly regarding Iran Earlier in May, Trump lashed out at several US media outlets, particularly The New York Times, The Wall Street Journal, and CNN, over their coverage of the ongoing situation with Iran, accusing them of misrepresenting Tehran's military position amid the escalating situation. In a post on Truth Social, Trump wrote that even if Iran were to surrender completely, its navy and air force destroyed, military leadership capitulating, and necessary surrender documents signed, the media would still portray the country as achieving a "masterful and brilliant victory over the United States". The US President also slammed the Democrats in the US and criticised the faction media as well as his political rivals, claiming that "They have gone absolutely CRAZY." "If Iran surrenders, admits their Navy is gone and resting at the bottom of the sea, and their Air Force is no longer with us, and if their entire Military walks out of Tehran, weapons dropped and hands held high, each shouting "I surrender, I surrender" while wildly waving the representative White Flag, and if their entire remaining Leadership signs all necessary "Documents of Surrender," and admit their defeat to the great power and force of the magnificent U.S.A., The Failing New York Times, The China Street Journal (WSJ!), Corrupt and now Irrelevant CNN, and all other members of the Fake News Media, will headline that Iran had a Masterful and Brilliant Victory over The United States of America, it wasn't even close," Trump had written. Meanwhile, tensions in West Asia continue, with reports indicating that Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has urged the US administration to consider renewed military action against Tehran. (ANI)

(This story has not been edited by Devdiscourse staff and is auto-generated from a syndicated feed.)

item.content:encoded:
日経平均は反発で寄り付く、米ハイテク株の戻り歩調受け　大幅安の反動も 9:25 配信

東京証券取引所。4月6日、東京で撮影。REUTERS/Issei Kato（ロイター） [東京 ２６日 ロイター] - 寄り付きの東京株式市場で日経平均は、前営業日比０．７３％（４１７円９２銭）高の５万７４２９円５４銭と、反発してスタートした。前日の米国株式市場で軟化したハイテク株が戻り歩調となったことを受け、ＡＩ（人工知能）・半導体関連株が買い先行。そのほか、バリュー株も物色された。突っ込み警戒感が生じているとの見方もあり、前日の大幅安の反動高の様相を呈している。

個別では、トヨタ自動車がしっかり。ソニーグループが連日の年初来高値更新となっている。ＡＩ・半導体関連はアドバンテスト、東京エレクトロン、ソフトバンクグループなどが高い。半面、ファーストリテイリングは安寄りした。

item.title: エンブラエル機への関税案、米航空各社のコスト増に 代替なく
item.description:
Allison Lampert Gabriel Araujo
[２５日 ロイター] - 米政府が提案したエンブラエルの...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
エンブラエル機への関税案、米航空各社のコスト増に　代替なく 9:03 配信

2026年6月9日、ブラジルのサン・ジョゼ・ドス・カンポスにあるエンブラエル本社に並ぶ商用ジェット機。 REUTERS/Gabriel Araujo/File Photo（ロイター） Allison Lampert　Gabriel Araujo

[２５日 ロイター] - 米政府が提案したエンブラエルのブラジル製完成機に対する１０％の関税について、アナリストや業界幹部は２５日、米国製の代替機がない米航空各社のコストを押し上げるとの見方を示した。トランプ政権は航空機市場を通商交渉の圧力手段として利用している。

米国の主要輸出分野である航空宇宙産業はこれまで、自動車や鉄鋼、アルミニウムなど他の産業を直撃したトランプ大統領の関税をおおむね免れてきた。

トランプ氏は２５日、日本、中国、欧州連合（ＥＵ）を含む１４の貿易相手国・地域に対し、新たな関税措置を提案。その一環として、ブラジル製の民間航空機などへの予想外の関税を打ち出した。

関税は早ければ来年１月にも導入される可能性がある。米航空各社がイラン戦争に伴うジェット燃料価格の急騰に苦慮する中、エンブラエル機の購入価格が上昇することになる。

航空宇宙コンサルティング会社エアロダイナミック・アドバイザリーのマネジングディレクター、リチャード・アブラフィア氏は「エンブラエルのジェット旅客機には米国の競合製品がない」と述べた。

企業の開示資料によると、第３・四半期末時点でエンブラエルのＥ１７５型機の確定受注残は、米アメリカン航空、スカイウエスト航空、リパブリック航空向けの合計で約１６０機だった。

item.title: 新興国向けプライベート投資、1－9月は19％増 テク・ＡＩで活発
item.description:
Libby George
[ロンドン ２５日 ロイター] - 民間投資家団体グローバル・プライベート・キャピタル協会（...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
新興国向けプライベート投資、1－9月は19％増　テク・ＡＩで活発 8:59 配信

2025年4月11日、上海でモニターに表示された株価指数。 REUTERS/Go Nakamura REFILE - QUALITY REPEAT（ロイター） Libby George

[ロンドン ２５日 ロイター] - 民間投資家団体グローバル・プライベート・キャピタル協会（ＧＰＣＡ）が発表した新興国向けのプライベート・キャピタル（株式や債券などの公開市場を経由せず企業やプロジェクトに投資される民間資金）投資は、今年１－９月期で前年同期比１９％増の１４３２億ドルとなった。中国のテクノロジー分野への投資拡大やインフラ需要の高まりが押し上げ要因となった。

投資総額は２０２５年通年の１５８３億ドルに迫っており、エヌビディアやアンソロピックを巡る市場の変動があったにもかかわらず、テクノロジーや人工知能（ＡＩ）分野への旺盛な投資需要を示した。

プライベート・キャピタルは新興国経済にとって重要な資金供給源。各国政府の財政余力の低下や借入コストの上昇により、従来型の資金調達が制約を受ける中、投資不足を補う役割を果たしている。

・中国向け投資は６４３億ドルと、２５年通年実績のほぼ２倍に達し、２２年以来の高水準となった。

・ＧＰＣＡの調査担当マネージングディレクター、ジェフ・シュラピンスキー氏は「ＡＩ関連スタートアップや中国向けだけでなく、ロボティクスや航空宇宙分野への資金流入も今年大きく加速している」と述べた。

・ＧＰＣＡは新興国市場で２兆ドル超の資産を運用する投資家で構成され、プライベートクレジット、プライベートエクイティ、ベンチャーキャピタルのほか、インフラや天然資源への投資動向を調査している。

・中国を除く地域では、インフラ投資が資金流入をけん引した。アフリカ向けは５２億ドル、中東・東欧向けは１０７億ドルとなり、いずれも既に２５年通年実績を上回った。

・投資資金は化石燃料、通信、データセンター分野に流入しており、投資家の間では成長市場向けインフラ投資専用ファンドの組成も進んでいる。

・シュラピンスキー氏は「世界的な不確実性や高インフレ、高金利の環境下で、多くの資産配分担当者は実物資産へと資金を振り向けている」と述べた。

・こうした動きは先進国市場の傾向とも一致。世界の投資データを集計するプレキンによると、今年はプライベートエクイティやプライベートクレジットへの資金流入が増加しており、とりわけＡＩとインフラ分野に投資が集中している。

・中東向け投資は１－９月で２４億ドルと、前年同期の２１６億ドルから大幅に減少した。

・シュラピンスキー氏は「全体として投資家はより慎重かつ選別的な姿勢を強めている」と述べ、戦争による経済的影響を見極めようとしているとの見方を示した。

ロイター 関連リンク アングル：中国「独身の日」、世界最大級セールでＡＩトークンが新たな目玉に アングル：巧妙化するサイバー攻撃、攻撃する側もされる側も「ＡＩ武装」 焦点：オープンＡＩの甘いセキュリティー管理、従業員は以前から警鐘 アングル：「身体を持つＡＩ」、中国ロボット業界が巨額投資　米企業と競争激化 アングル：米ナスダック１００、10月に時価総額2兆ドル超消失　ＡＩ巨額投資に厳しい目 11/26(木) 8:59 最終更新 ロイター

US CDC reports nine measles-related deaths in 2026

A sign reading 'measles testing' is seen in Seminole, Texas, US, on Feb 25, 2025. (File photo: Reuters/Sebastian Rocandio)

26 Nov 2026 06:43AM (Updated: 26 Nov 2026 06:45AM)

FAST

The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention reported nine measles-related deaths in the United States this year, as the country battles its worst outbreak of the highly contagious viral infection in decades. The US had recorded 6,039 confirmed measles cases as of Nov 24, across 47 jurisdictions, according to the agency's website on Wednesday. That includes 18 cases among international visitors. The CDC updated its tally after the National Center for Health Statistics received additional reports from states and verified that the deaths had occurred and that measles was the underlying cause, a Department of Health and Human Services spokesperson said. Based on publicly reported state figures, however, the US has recorded at least 14 measles-associated deaths this year, including nine fatalities in Pennsylvania, three in Wisconsin and one each in Virginia and New York state.

A discrepancy between state and federal death tallies arose earlier this year after CDC, under US Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr., began using National Center for Health Statistics mortality data instead of state figures. "The discrepancy between state and federal measles-related death figures is concerning and risks confusing the public about the true toll of this outbreak," said Frederic Bertley, immunologist and CEO of the Center of Science and Industry. "Regardless of the precise number, these deaths are alarming and reflect the consequences of declining vaccination coverage," Bertley said. Cases in the US have reached a 35-year high, a resurgence driven largely by unvaccinated people that this month stripped the country of its hard-fought measles elimination status . CDC data showed that 671 patients, or 11 per cent of confirmed cases, were hospitalised, with children aged under 5 years recording the highest hospitalisation rate at 17 per cent. The agency also said the death count could change as it reviews additional information. On Wednesday, Pennsylvania, the hardest-hit US state, reported 1,679 measles cases so far this year, including 87 new cases over the past seven days and 340 hospitalisations.

Israeli judges recommend prosecutors drop one bribery case against Netanyahu

Israeli judges have recommended dropping one of three corruption cases against Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and reconsidering another, in a trial that began in 2020.

Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu arrives to speak to the media at the Knesset, Israel's parliament in Jerusalem, Nov 25, 2026. (Photo: REUTERS/Ronen Zvulun)

26 Nov 2026 05:24AM

FAST

JERUSALEM: Israeli judges on Wednesday (Nov 25) recommended that prosecutors drop one of three long-running cases against Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and reconsider another alleging he granted favours in exchange for positive media coverage. Netanyahu was indicted in 2019 on charges of bribery, fraud and breach of trust. He denies the charges and has pleaded not guilty. His trial began in 2020 and involves three criminal cases. In the case referred to as Case 4000, prosecutors allege that Netanyahu granted regulatory favours worth around 1.8 billion shekels (about US$500 million) to Bezeq Telecom Israel. In return, prosecutors say, he sought positive coverage for himself and his wife, Sara, on a news website controlled by former Bezeq Chairman Shaul Elovitch. Elovitch has denied wrongdoing. In a blow to prosecutors, Judge Rivka Friedman-Feldman of Jerusalem District Court , who presides over Case 4000, told Attorney General Gali Baharav-Miara at a hearing on Wednesday that a conviction was unlikely and the case should be dropped.

The recommendation was not a ruling on the case, the court clarified, and Baharav-Miara said she would review the court's statements with the prosecution. The judges also recommended prosecutors reconsider so-called Case 2000 because of doubts that Netanyahu's actions constituted a criminal offence. In that case, prosecutors allege Netanyahu negotiated a deal with Arnon Mozes, owner of Israel's Yedioth Ahronoth newspaper, for better coverage in return for legislation to slow the growth of a rival newspaper. Netanyahu on Wednesday called the court's recommendation a "ray of light for truth and justice." "Ten years of suffering for dozens of my close ones who were dragged into interrogation rooms," Netanyahu said in a televised address. "Where they were blackmailed with criminal acts, humiliated, and the lives of many of them were ruined, just so they would give false testimony against me."

item.description: The charitable entities controlling the Tata Group are set to challenge N Chandrasekaran's reappointment as Tata Sons chairman ...
item.content:encoded:
Home / Companies / News / Tata Trusts to challenge Chandrasekaran's reappointment in Bombay HC

Tata Trusts to challenge Chandrasekaran's reappointment in Bombay HC The charitable entities controlling the Tata Group are set to challenge N Chandrasekaran's reappointment as Tata Sons chairman

The dispute follows N Chandrasekaran's reappointment as Tata Sons executive chairman for another five years at the September 17 board meeting

Press Trust of India Mumbai 2 min read Last Updated : Nov 26 2026 | 10:40 AM IST

Listen to This Article

The Sir Dorabji Tata Trust (SDTT) and the R.D. Tata Trust (RDTT) will file suits in the Bombay High Court against Tata Sons and six of its directors, challenging the reappointment of N Chandrasekaran as executive chairman for a second five-year term. The SDTT will seek ₹50 crore and RDTT will seek ₹15 crore in damages, with 18 per cent annual interest. As per the suits, the September 17 decision to reappoint Chandrasekaran was invalid because it did not receive the affirmative vote required under Article 121 of the company's Articles of Association. The dispute follows N Chandrasekaran's reappointment as Tata Sons executive chairman for another five years at the September 17 board meeting.

The two trusts voted on Wednesday night to pass the resolutions to move HC as there was a lack of any satisfactory replies to the communications sent by them since September 17. Also Read

Now, Noel wants revision of Tata Sons board agenda, pushes restructuring

RBI has already answered its own listing question in case of Tata Sons premium

Tata Sons defers board meeting to Nov 30 as Noel asks for 7-day notice

Tata Sons board meet postponed to Nov 30 after Noel raises concerns

RBI Act may show the way on Tata Sons listing amid regulatory uncertainty premium

The immediate relief being sought is to ensure that the chairman during the November 30 meeting is prevented from exercising his casting vote in the event of a split in opinion among nominee directors. Tata Trusts, chaired by Noel Tata, holds around 66 per cent of Tata Sons and has challenged the board resolution passed on September 17. In its September 20 statement, the Trusts said the resolution was not validly passed and had "no legal effect".

At the centre of the dispute are Tata Sons' Articles of Association (AoA) and special rights given to Trusts-nominated directors. It has two nominee directors on its board -- Noel Tata and Venu Srinivasan. On September 17, Noel Tata voted against Chandrasekaran's reappointment, while Venu Srinivasan supported it. As per Trusts, both nominated directors were required to support the decision. In its statement issued in September, the Trusts said the AoA of Tata Sons provide that no decision can be taken unless it has the affirmative support of at least a majority of the Directors nominated by the Tata Trusts. "This is a separate condition under the AoA," it said, pointing out that the AoA does not leave any decision of the board to a mere head count of directors.

(Only the headline and picture of this report may have been reworked by the Business Standard staff; the rest of the content is auto-generated from a syndicated feed.)

item.title: Can price floors fund rare earth projects beyond China?
item.description: Western buyers are paying steep premiums for rare earths as China restricts exports.
item.dc:creator: Northern Miner Staff
item.content:encoded:
Can price floors fund rare earth projects beyond China? Western buyers are paying steep premiums for rare earths as China restricts exports.

Blair McBride | November 25, 2026 - 4:08 pm

Categories: Australia NZ South Pacific China News Rare Earth USA

Rare earth production line at Lynas’ plant in Kuantan, Malaysia. ( Image from Lynas’ presentation. )

Western buyers are paying steep premiums for rare earths as China restricts exports. Whether those premiums can help finance new mines and refineries outside China depends on the price buyers will guarantee for years, Sprott (TSX, NYSE: SII) says.

High-purity yttrium oxide, used in jet engine coatings, traded at about $1,650 per kg in North America on Nov. 17, roughly 185 times the Chinese price of about $9. Few processors outside China can supply the separated rare earths manufacturers need, Sprott’s Paul Wong and Jacob White wrote in a Nov. 24 report on the sector.

“Higher prices cannot quickly resolve this concentration,” Wong and White wrote. “Secure supply requires separation, refining, metallurgy and magnet manufacturing, not simply new mines.”

The price a buyer pays for scarce oxide today tells a lender little about what a refinery will earn once it opens. A long-term contract with a minimum price gives the lender a figure it can use to judge whether the project can repay a construction loan. The yttrium price gap is likely to narrow, but even a smaller premium could make Western projects viable, the authors said.

In California, MP Materials (NYSE: MP) has a 10-year agreement with the U.S. Department of Defense that sets a $110-per-kg floor for neodymium-praseodymium in products it sells or stockpiles from its Mountain Pass mine. MP booked $8.1 million in price protection income in the quarter to Sept. 30, the company said this month.

Australia’s Lynas Rare Earths (ASX: LYC; US-OTC: LYSCF) had minimum prices in place for more than half its output by late October. Offering dysprosium and terbium alongside neodymium and praseodymium helps Lynas win longer contracts with magnet makers, Interim CEO Pol Le Roux told analysts in October. Lynas set up a price floor for rare earth sales in March with JARE, a venture involving Japan’s Jogmec and Sojitz. In May 2025, Lynas became the first producer of separated heavy rare earth oxides outside China.

Export curbs

China mined 60% of the world’s magnet rare earths in 2024, refined 91% and made 94% of its sintered permanent magnets, according to the International Energy Agency . Dysprosium and terbium help those magnets retain their strength at the high temperatures inside electric motors.

In Europe, dysprosium oxide fetched about $4,875 per kg on Nov. 17, nearly 22 times the Chinese price. Terbium oxide traded at about $10,500 per kg in Europe against $944 in China, according to Benchmark Mineral Intelligence and Bloomberg figures cited by Sprott.

China shipped an average of 19.3 tonnes a month of controlled rare earth compounds and metals to the U.S. from November 2025 through September, down 75% from 76.8 tonnes a month between June 2024 and March 2025, according to Sprott. It used trade figures from Silverado Policy Accelerator for products fully covered by China’s April 2025 export controls. The figures exclude finished magnets.

Beijing has suspended broader controls on rare earths and related technology through Jan. 10, 2027. The April licensing rules still apply to certain rare earths and magnets.

South Africa’s Steenkampskraal mine has lined up buyers in China for its first concentrate sales, expected in early 2027, Finance Chief Tyrone Searle told The Northern Miner in October. The operation is owned by privately held Steenkampskraal Monazite Mine.

The mine operator and France’s Remedy Metals have since signed a non-binding agreement to test whether they can separate rare earths at Steenkampskraal. They plan to start with ore samples in a laboratory before deciding whether to run a pilot at the mine, Mining Weekly reported Wednesday.

Equity financing

Developers raising money by selling shares face a tougher market. The Sprott Rare Earths Ex-China ETF (Nasdaq: REXC), which tracks rare earth companies outside China, closed at $11.09 Tuesday, down 30% from $15.76 on Sept. 30. A developer whose own shares fall must issue more of them to raise the same construction dollars.

Wong and White attributed much of the sell-off to investors cutting positions bought with borrowed money as markets grew more volatile. Net inflows into Sprott’s fund topped $100 million between April and Nov. 17, according to Bloomberg data compiled by the asset manager.

item.title: Kazatomprom operations chief detained in bribery probe
item.description: The uranium miner said its board removed Omarbekov and chief commercial officer Vladislav Baiguzhin and reassigned their duties.
item.dc:creator: Northern Miner Staff
item.content:encoded:
Kazatomprom operations chief detained in bribery probe The uranium miner said its board removed Omarbekov and chief commercial officer Vladislav Baiguzhin and reassigned their duties.

Henry Lazenby | November 25, 2026 - 3:36 pm

Categories: Asia Canada News stock-markets-investing Uranium

A Kazatomprom uranium exploration site in Kazakhstan. Credit: Kazatomprom

Kazakhstan’s anti-corruption service detained Kazatomprom’s (LSE: KAP) head of operations as a bribery investigation widened from the country’s sovereign wealth fund to the world’s largest uranium miner.

Officers detained Kuanysh Omarbekov and others Monday, the National Security Committee said Wednesday. Investigators suspect them of involvement in a corruption scheme allegedly organized by former leaders of state investment fund Samruk-Kazyna. The fund managed $88 billion in assets at the end of 2025 and owns 63% of Kazatomprom.

The miner said its board removed Omarbekov and chief commercial officer Vladislav Baiguzhin on Tuesday and reassigned their duties to other managers.

“The company reassures that its production and commercial teams at operational levels remain intact with ongoing business and day-to-day operations continuing as usual,” Kazatomprom said Wednesday.

The detentions deepen a corruption investigation into Kazakhstan’s state-owned businesses, raising questions about oversight at companies central to the country’s economy and international mineral supply chains.

Kazatomprom’s global depositary receipts fell nearly 10% to close at $49.80 in London on Wednesday, valuing the company at $12.9 billion.

Large scale

Omarbekov oversaw exploration, drilling, mining and processing for a company whose share of production accounted for about one-fifth of the world’s mined uranium last year. Kazatomprom expects the operations in which it holds stakes to produce 27,500–29,000 tonnes of uranium this year, including 14,500–15,500 tonnes for its own account.

The committee is investigating under a provision of Kazakhstan’s criminal code that covers giving a bribe on an especially large scale or by a criminal group. It withheld further details, citing rules on pretrial investigations.

Kazatomprom said it was cooperating with investigators. Omarbekov ran KAP Logistics, Kazatomprom’s procurement and transport arm, from 2018 to 2022. He then led Akbastau, a uranium mining venture in southern Kazakhstan owned equally by Kazatomprom and Rosatom’s Uranium One, before becoming operations chief in June 2023.

Uranium deliveries

Kazatomprom’s share of uranium output rose 12% to 10,969 tonnes in the first nine months of the year. Its Canadian partner Cameco (TSX: CCO; NYSE: CCJ) owns 40% of the Inkai mine in southern Kazakhstan. Kazatomprom owns the rest.

Cameco said in its third-quarter results that it expected to buy 4.2 million lb. of uranium oxide from Inkai’s projected output of 10.4 million lb. this year. By the time Cameco reported on Oct. 30, a shipment carrying 1.6 million lb. of its share had reached the Blind River refinery in Ontario. The final shipment was en route and due before year-end.

Fund’s tungsten deal

The anti-corruption service had already detained the heads of Samruk-Kazyna and the national railway on Nov. 11. Prime Minister Olzhas Bektenov, who chairs the fund’s board of directors, called on Nov. 18 for tighter oversight of the fund and its subsidiaries, particularly by their audit and risk committees.

“This is an extremely serious signal of large-scale corruption in state-owned companies,” President Kassym-Jomart Tokayev told Kazakhstan’s Security Council on Nov. 13, referring to the detentions of the heads of Samruk-Kazyna and the national railway.

The fund’s then-chief, Nurlan Zhakupov, witnessed the signing in February of agreements between its mining company, Tau-Ken Samruk, and U.S.-based Cove Kaz Capital Group. Cove committed at least $1.1 billion to develop the Northern Katpar and Upper Kairakty tungsten deposits and process the metal in Kazakhstan.

The security committee’s statements on the November detentions identify no tungsten transaction as part of the alleged scheme.

US financing scrutiny

The venture drew scrutiny in Washington because U.S. President Donald Trump’s sons, Donald Jr. and Eric, hold an indirect stake. U.S. Sen. Elizabeth Warren questioned in July how the U.S. Export-Import Bank would protect taxpayers from conflicts of interest. The Trump Organization told Fox News the brothers were passive investors and had no advance knowledge of the award.

The Export-Import Bank and the U.S. International Development Finance Corp. had expressed interest in providing up to $1.6 billion between them. Reuters reported Nov. 10 that neither lender was actively pursuing the financing. Cove said it had yet to apply.

'Russia wants more than Ukraine,' says Germany's Merz as he defends aid for Kyiv

German Chancellor Friedrich Merz speaks on the day of the 2027 budget debate at the German lower house of parliament, the Bundestag, in Berlin, Germany, Nov 25, 2026. (Photo: REUTERS/Liesa Johannssen)

BERLIN: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz accused Russia on Wednesday (Nov 25) of "escalating" threats to European security as he defended his government's plans to bolster defence spending and maintain financial aid to Ukraine. Opposition parties, including t he far-right Alternative for Germany (AfD), which tops national opinion polls, and t he hard-left Die Linke, have called for an end to military aid to Kyiv . "It cannot be s aid often enough, against t he far right as much as t he far left: Russia knows exactly what it wants . And Russia wants more than Ukraine," Merz told t he Bundestag lower house of parliament during a debate on t he 2027 draft budget. "Russia is escalating in t he Baltic region, in Poland, on t he Black Sea; Russia is escalating in space, and Russia is by now also escalating massively he re in our own country," he s aid .

Russia did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment on Merz 's accusations. It has repeatedly denied seeking military confrontation with NATO countries and says its actions in Ukraine are aimed at protecting its own national security. Merz 's government blamed Russia in September for an attempted drone attack at Leipzig/Halle airport , an accusation t he Russian Embassy in Berlin dismissed as part of a "new wave of anti-Russian hysteria in Germany". Germany and ot he r European countries have also been hit by a wave of cyberattacks and sabotage incidents targeting critical infrastructure that t he y have often blamed on Russia. Moscow has denied all t he allegations.

"LEARNING FROM UKRAINE" Merz s aid on Wednesday that by supporting Ukraine, Germany was also protecting itself. "We are learning from Ukraine - technologically for civilian use but of course also in defence technology," he s aid . Germany has been Ukraine's biggest military backer in Europe since Russia's full-blown invasion on Feb 24, 2022, but public support for this policy has decreased amid cost-of-living pressures. A poll publis he d on Tuesday showed a narrow majority of Germans now oppose giving military aid to Kyiv . "Whose chancellor are you, actually?" AfD co-leader Tino Chrupalla asked Merz during Wednesday's debate, accusing the government of supporting Ukraine while failing to provide sufficient relief to German citizens. "What a mockery!" Germany aims to double defence spending to over €200 billion (US$228 billion) between now and 2030, according to t he 2027 draft budget, hitting 3.7 per cent of national output by 2030, in line with commitments to NATO.

Related:

Ukraine says Russian strikes kill 14 in Kyiv region

Russia-Ukraine war: Witkoff says there is basis for ceasefire, calls to resume 3-way talks

Commentary: Historic Xi-Trump-Putin summit reveals an unsettling truth about great power diplomacy

EU SHOULD FOCUS ON SECURITY AND COMPETITIVENESS, MERZ SAYS Merz also addressed on Wednesday t he latest proposal for t he European Union budget for 2028-2034 presented by European Council chief Antonio Costa. Costa proposed cuts that would reduce t he overall seven-year budget to €1.582 trillion, some €40 billion less than a proposal presented by t he Irish EU presidency in October. EU leaders will discuss Costa's proposals at a special summit on Thursday and Friday. "In t he se negotiations I am pushing for spending to be limited and focused on what really makes Europe stronger: security and competitiveness," Merz s aid . "If spending is focused, it is t he best additional insurance for our country."

Source: Reuters/fs

item.title: Glencore taps former CEO’s nephew to lead coal unit
item.description: Colin Glasenberg has been working at Glencore since 2011, and his uncle, Ivan Glasenberg led the company for 20 years.
item.dc:creator: Marina Meireles
item.content:encoded:
Glencore taps former CEO’s nephew to lead coal unit  Colin Glasenberg has been working at Glencore since 2011, and his uncle, Ivan Glasenberg led the company for 20 years.

Marina Meireles | November 25, 2026 - 9:43 am

Categories: Coal Europe Top Companies

Ivan Glasenberg, Glencore's former chief executive officer ( Image: Wikipedia )

Glencore (LON: GLEN) has appointed Colin Glasenberg, the nephew of former chief executive officer and the company’s largest shareholder Ivan Glasenberg, to lead its massive coal mining unit.

Colin Glasenberg, who joined the Swiss commodities giant in 2011 and has served as its industrial lead for oil since 2020, succeeds Earl Melamed, who is retiring after three decades with the company.

Mark Power, currently an asset manager in the energy business, is set to replace Glasenberg as head of oil assets, Bloomberg reported.

Glencore produces about 130 million tonnes of coal annually, generating $4.85 billion of adjusted core earnings in 2025. It is the top global coal shipper and is benefitting from coal demand due to the energy and oil crisis caused by geopolitical conflicts, like the closure of the Strait of Hormuz and the Russia-Ukraine war.

Coal demand to rise 1.2% as Hormuz closure drives gas prices: IEA

Ivan Glasenberg was Glencore’s CEO from until his retirement in 2021. Today he holds 10.42% of Glencore’s shares valued at about $8.33 million.

Glencore didn’t provide comments on Glasenberg’s appointment.

Shares in Glencore were down 2% to £432.25 apiece by market close on Wednesday in London, valuing the company at £50.6 billion ($66.2 billion).

(With files from Bloomberg and Reuters)

item.title: US military pause clouds Ecuador’s illegal mining fight
item.description: A Pentagon probe raises uncertainty over efforts to combat criminal gangs that have infiltrated Ecuador’s gold supply chain.
item.dc:creator: Cecilia Jamasmie
item.content:encoded:
US military pause clouds Ecuador’s illegal mining fight A Pentagon probe raises uncertainty over efforts to combat criminal gangs that have infiltrated Ecuador’s gold supply chain.

Cecilia Jamasmie | November 25, 2026 - 6:37 am

Categories: Copper Gold Regulatory Issues South America United States

Ecuadorian President Daniel Noboa meets US Secretary of War Pete Hegseth. ( Image courtesy of Hegseth | X. )

Ecuador’s Interior Minister John Reimberg reaffirmed the country’s security partnership with Washington following reports that the Trump administration had suspended joint military operations, raising uncertainty over efforts to combat drug trafficking and illegal mining.

Talks last week with US Secretary of War Pete Hegseth focused on reviewing operations, determining next steps and identifying Ecuador’s operational needs, Reimberg said in a radio interview Wednesday, Reuters reported. He described the discussions as productive, pointing to an established action plan between the two countries.

“Some would like to see these relationships, which have yielded so many positive results, damaged,” Reimberg said.

The remarks follow reports Tuesday by The New York Times and The Atlantic that Washington halted joint operations in mid-October. The US Department of Defense reportedly launched an investigation into alleged human rights violations during a Sept. 23 operation by Ecuadorian forces in Manabí province that killed a suspected criminal leader.

The reported suspension comes at a critical juncture for Ecuador, which in July elevated illegal mining to a national security threat after concluding that criminal gangs had infiltrated the country’s gold supply chain, turning the sector into a major source of financing for organized crime.

Ecuadorian President Daniel Noboa and Hegseth discussed expanding technological assistance, port security and border surveillance during last week’s visit. However, no new agreement was signed amid domestic political sensitivities ahead of the Nov. 29 local elections.

Noboa announced in March that Ecuador would conduct joint operations with the US and other allies, describing the initiative as “a new phase” in the fight against narco-terrorism and illegal mining. While the initiative has garnered public support, Ecuadorians voted last year against allowing foreign military bases on national territory.

Criminal gold

Ecuador’s 2026–2029 National Security Plan identifies illegal mining as a strategic security challenge rather than simply an environmental or regulatory issue.

The government says criminal organizations use illicit gold production to launder drug trafficking proceeds while supplying mining operations with machinery, chemicals and armed protection.

Gangs hijack Ecuador’s gold mining supply chain

The strategy reflects growing concern over the profitability of illicit gold production, which is fuelling violence and environmental destruction while exposing vulnerabilities in Ecuador’s mineral supply chain.

The plan identifies Los Lobos as the country’s dominant criminal organization in illegal mining. A report by the Global Initiative Against Transnational Organized Crime (GI-TOC) similarly concludes that the gang operates across the gold value chain, from extraction to exports through the ports of Guayaquil and Puerto Bolívar.

Regional resistance

The Trump administration’s push to expand military co-operation under its American Coalition Against the Cartels faces political obstacles elsewhere in Latin America, where governments must balance security priorities with concerns over sovereignty and the legacy of US military interventions.

During Hegseth’s recent trip, Colombian President Abelardo De La Espriella told Washington he lacked congressional support to authorize joint military operations, The New York Times reported.

Nearly 70% of Ecuador’s protected areas are located in the Napo province, where most illegal miners are active.

De La Espriella denied the report , while Hegseth said on X that the alliance between the two countries was “stronger than ever.”

Adam Isacson, a security expert at the Washington Office on Latin America, said the suspension in Ecuador and the lukewarm reception Hegseth received from right-wing governments suggested the Trump administration’s strategy of conducting joint strikes across the region was “losing momentum.”

The Pentagon maintained in a statement to the NYT that US military officers remained “committed to working alongside sovereign partners, including Ecuador, to confront narco-terrorist networks.”

(With files from Reuters)

item.title: New US tariff may give India edge over Asian peers if trade deal done: GTRI
item.description: GTRI said a proposed 17% US tariff under a trade pact would give India a slight edge over Asian competitors, while the rate could rise to 25% without an agreement.
item.content:encoded:
Home / World News / New US tariff may give India edge over Asian peers if trade deal done: GTRI

New US tariff may give India edge over Asian peers if trade deal done: GTRI GTRI said a proposed 17% US tariff under a trade pact would give India a slight edge over Asian competitors, while the rate could rise to 25% without an agreement.

India's proposed tariff rate under a potential US trade pact could be lower than those faced by several Asian competitors, giving Indian exporters a slight advantage, according to GTRI. | Image: Bloomberg

Press Trust of India 2 min read Last Updated : Nov 26 2026 | 12:11 AM IST

Listen to This Article

India could face a 17 per cent US tariff if a bilateral trade agreement is finalised, giving it a slight edge over several Asian competitors, but the rate could rise to 25 per cent without a pact, think tank GTRI said on Wednesday, warning of possible additional duties or import quotas.   India must reject the trade deal and instead answer allegations sector by sector, it said.   The answers should clearly show that India's investment serves domestic buyers, overseas customers, and future demand, the Global Trade Research Initiative (GTRI) said.   "Under the proposed USTR tariffs, Indian imports face a 17 per cent tariff if a trade pact is finalised, offering a calculated 1 per cent edge over Bangladesh, Cambodia, Indonesia, Malaysia, and Thailand (18 per cent deal rate) and a 3 per cent edge over Vietnam and China (20 per cent deal rate), while rising up to 25 per cent without a deal, alongside the risk that an adverse USTR ruling could bring further duties or import quotas," GTRI Founder Ajay Srivastava said.

These new tariffs proposed on November 25 by the US Trade Representative (USTR) were under Section 301 excess-capacity investigations. Also Read

Section 301 probe: India rejects US claim of structural excess capacity

US proposes up to 25% tariff on India, offers 17% upon trade deal

Trump rebuilds global tariff wall, India faces proposed duties of up to 25%

US proposes new tariffs on 14 trading partners, including India and China

Asian stocks tumble as AI rebound stumbles, US tariff threats loom

Initiated by the Office of the United States Trade Representative (USTR) on March 11, 2026, against 16 economies, the proposed duties target 14 trading partners while excluding Mexico and Norway for now.   "By deploying a dual-rate structure, threatening steep baseline tariffs against countries that refuse a pact while offering lower rates to those that sign, Washington reclaims the bargaining power to impose duties at will and extract unilateral concessions, allowing a government to secure tariff relief even if the industrial capacity that prompted the investigation remains unchanged," he said.

For India, the Section 301 investigation flags potential excess capacity or export surpluses across seven sectors: solar modules (where capacity is nearly triple domestic demand), petrochemicals, steel, textiles, health-related goods, construction materials, and automotive products.   More From This Section

item.title: Copper price erases Nvidia rebound as investors steer clear of metals
item.description: Traders have booked up to 100,000 tonnes of US copper for China, a sign they are losing faith in tariffs, BMO Capital Markets says.
item.dc:creator: Frik Els
item.content:encoded:
Copper price erases Nvidia rebound as investors steer clear of metals Traders have booked up to 100,000 tonnes of US copper for China, a sign they are losing faith in tariffs, BMO Capital Markets says.

Staff Writer | November 24, 2026 - 10:53 am

Categories: China Copper Markets United States

Stock image.

Copper gave back all of Monday’s artificial intelligence-fuelled gains on Tuesday as investors who dumped metals during the recent AI rout showed little appetite to return, and traders kept moving US stockpiles to China.

Comex copper for December delivery fell 3.5% to $5.437 a pound ($11,985 a tonne) in morning trade in New York. A settlement at that level would be the lowest since March 24. The contract settled at $5.634 on Monday, up 2.7% but well off the session high of $5.787 reached after Nvidia reinstated Jensen Huang as chief executive.

Tuesday’s drop leaves copper 21% below its record settlement of $6.889 on September 9, technically a bear market. The metal is now down 3% this year and 16% in November.

Three-month copper on the London Metal Exchange was down 3.5% at $12,054 a tonne in official trading after briefly ducking below $12,000, Reuters reports. It had jumped as much as 5.3% on Monday.

Investors who sold commodities during the AI rout that followed Huang’s resignation on November 12 are not rushing back.

“These investors are not fully reengaging the positions they had pre-event, which includes commodity exposure,” Panmure Liberum analyst Tom Price told Reuters. Many have decided copper is too volatile and are cutting commodity exposure to concentrate on AI stocks, he said.

“There are now multiple reasons for the market to short copper,” Aces Zhou, a base metals trader at Hangzhou Chenglian Industrial, told Bloomberg. Beyond the AI narrative, he said, trade flows are starting to reverse as copper leaves the United States, and the factors that supported the metal’s two-year rally are unravelling.

Rate hikes and a strong dollar add to the headwinds. Markets are fully pricing a quarter-point increase at the Federal Reserve’s December meeting, which would be the second this year, Bloomberg reports, and the dollar index is at its highest since March 2025, according to BMO Capital Markets.

US metal heads to China

The physical market remains tight, but financial flows have overpowered it, BMO’s analysts wrote after attending Asia Copper Week in Shanghai last week. Visible exchange inventories cover only about two days of consumption, and the Yangshan premium for imports into China climbed from under $100 a tonne to around $500 in a month.

Those premiums, together with a narrowing gap between New York and London prices, have prompted traders to book an estimated 30,000 to 100,000 tonnes of US cathode for direct shipment to China, BMO said. The metal, held outside exchange warehouses on the US west coast, takes about two weeks to arrive.

The shipments matter less for the tonnage than for what they signal, BMO said: that traders are losing confidence in a tariff decision that would keep US stockpiles sealed off from the rest of the world. Chinese industry players expect President Donald Trump to drop plans for duties on refined copper, while Western participants still lean towards a tariff being imposed.

BMO expects the selloff to extend until Washington signals its tariff intentions or prices fall far enough to hit supply, potentially in the $10,000 to $11,000 a tonne range. Trafigura’s cost curve shows about 10% of copper produced by solvent extraction and electrowinning is already losing money at around $13,000, the bank said. BMO stands by its structurally bullish medium-term view.

Smelters squeezed

Talks on 2027 treatment charges, the fees miners pay smelters to process concentrate, remain far apart. Antofagasta has reportedly offered around minus $200 a tonne, while China’s Tongling has signalled about minus $80 could be acceptable, according to BMO.

This year’s benchmark was set at zero, already a record low, and BMO estimates some Chinese smelters break even on a cash basis at around minus $90. A deeply negative 2027 benchmark could speed up output cuts, especially as falling sulphuric acid prices erode by-product income.

Mine supply remains tight. Global copper mine production fell 1% year on year in September and is down 1% over the first nine months of 2026, the International Copper Study Group said in its latest monthly bulletin. Output from Chile slumped 15% and Peru 9% in the month, more than offsetting gains in Indonesia, China and the Democratic Republic of Congo. Refined demand fell 2% from a year earlier, slightly more than supply, leaving the refined market in deficit for the month, though it remains in surplus for the year to date.

Miners give back gains

Copper stocks reversed much of Monday’s rally. Freeport-McMoRan fell 5% at the New York open, cutting its market value to $68 billion, and Southern Copper lost 4% to $117 billion. Teck Resources dropped 4% to $25 billion, while BHP slipped 2% to $174 billion and Rio Tinto 2% to $125 billion. The five New York-listed heavyweights shed about $15 billion in the first minutes of trading, after adding more than $25 billion on Monday.

In London, Antofagasta dropped 7%, Anglo American almost 6% and Glencore 4%, while Poland’s KGHM fell 7%. In Toronto, First Quantum Minerals lost 6%, Lundin Mining and Hudbay Minerals 5% each and Ivanhoe Mines 4%.

BHP this week outlined plans to spend up to $17.4 billion to roughly double copper output in South Australia to about 650,000 tonnes a year by 2040, with a final investment decision expected in the first half of 2027.

First Quantum Minerals and Panama opened formal negotiations on Monday over the Cobre Panama mine, shut since 2023, after the company accepted the government’s five conditions for talks, including recognition that Panama owns the mineral resource.

Trader Trafigura has taken full control of the $260 million La Farola copper-gold project in Chile, buying the remaining 50% of owner Minera Altair as it moves from trading concentrate into mine development. In Santiago, the price slump is threatening President José Antonio Kast’s budget plans , as copper accounts for about half of the country’s exports.

(With files from Reuters and Bloomberg)

item.title: Namib Minerals pours first gold at historic Redwing gold mine
item.description: The mine in eastern Zimbabwe has been going through a phased restart, getting ready to restart commercial production.
item.dc:creator: Marina Meireles
item.content:encoded:
Namib Minerals pours first gold at historic Redwing gold mine The mine in eastern Zimbabwe has been going through a phased restart, getting ready to restart commercial production.

Marina Meireles | November 23, 2026 - 11:00 am

Categories: Africa Exploration Gold

( Image: Namib Minerals. )

Namib Minerals (Nasdaq: NAMM) has poured first gold at its century-old Redwing mine in eastern Zimbabwe, marking a return to commercial production after a seven-year hiatus.

The company said the milestone comes after mine infrastructure and processing facilities were rehabilitated and recommissioned. Redwing historically produced about 650,000 ounces of gold between 1981 and 2023.

“First gold is the beginning of the next phase, not the end of the job. Our focus now is to establish consistent, reliable production, demonstrate the operating performance of the mine and execute the planned ramp-up,” Namib CEO Tulani Sikwila said in a statement.

Namib Minerals aims to build a combined annual production of 300,000 ounces in the long-term between the Redwing, How mine and Mazowe mine, still subject to technical studies, permitting and financing. The company expects to spend $300 million on mine restarts, Reuters reported.

The Definitive Feasibility Study (DFS) is fully funded with a conclusion expected in the first quarter of 2027, followed by resource definition drilling, the company said.

Shares in Namib Minerals were slightly down 2.29% to $0.6 apiece by mid-day Monday in New York, valuing the company at $33.7 million.

Production ramp up

Namib Minerals said it is planning a staged ramp up, first trying to establish a reliable production record and stable mining and processing rhythm.

The company expects to increase mining and processing through the installation and commissioning of a higher capacity winder. It said it targets to increase ore processing and gold production in 2027, depending on operating conditions.

“Our ambition is to build a much larger African gold and critical metals business through operational delivery, disciplined capital allocation and responsible development,” Sikwila added.

Namib Minerals already owns and operates the How mine in Bulawayo, which produced 25,000 ounces of gold in 2025. With Redwing’s restart, the company now becomes a multi-asset producer.

(With files from Reuters)

item.title: テンセントがオラクルからAI半導体10万個をリース、70億ドル規模－FT
item.description:
（ブルームバーグ）： 中国のテンセント・ホールディングス（騰訊）は、東南アジアでオラクルから先端のAI半導体を借り受けることで合意した。テンセントにとってAI半導体のリース契約としては過去最大規模となる。英紙フィナンシャル・タイムズ（FT）が事情に詳しい関係者の話として報じた。
報道によると、テンセントは、5年間の契約の一環として10万個の半導体を利用できるようになる。契約額は70億ドル（約1兆1000億円）に上るという。
中国のAI開発企業は米国の輸出規制を回避するため、米エヌビディア製など中国国内では入手できないAIアクセラレーターを海外で借りて利用している。中国のテクノロジー企業は、東南アジアのデータセンターの最大顧客層の一つとなっている。
テンセントとオラクルの担当者は、ブルームバーグ・ニュースのコメント要請に直ちに応じなかった。
原題：Tencent Leases AI Chips From Oracle
